samstephenson.en: Product insight comes from watching real user behavior, not asking users what they think they do.
samstephenson.zh: 产品洞察来自观察真实用户行为，而非询问用户自认为在做什么。

samstephenson.en: Start from a single pain point, solve it well, then expand; subtraction beats feature accumulation.
samstephenson.zh: 从单一痛点出发，先解决好再扩展；做减法比堆功能更重要。

samstephenson.en: Treat AI as an intern needing context, not an omniscient note-taker; transcripts are raw material.
samstephenson.zh: 把 AI 当作需要上下文的实习生，而非全知全能的记录者；转录稿只是原材料。

samstephenson.en: Protect the core meeting flow ruthlessly; hiding transcripts is a deliberate trade-off.
samstephenson.zh: 坚决保护核心会议流程；刻意隐藏转录稿是一种有意的取舍。

samstephenson.en: The hard part is knowing what to build, not building fast; most stop too early after v1.
samstephenson.zh: 难的是知道该造什么，而非造得快；多数人在第一版后就过早停手。

fadell.en: Great products solve one pain at a time; design balances tech and human needs, and tech must be introduced gradually.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他强调：好产品一次只解决一个痛点，设计要平衡技术与人的需求，技术应逐步引入让社会适应。

fadell.en: Failure is a learning opportunity; take boredom breaks for clarity, and storytelling is core to leadership and product.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他把失败视为学习机会，主张在职业章节间留白以获得清晰，并把讲故事视为领导力与产品的核心。

fadell.en: Start with a press release; great ideas are painkillers not vitamins, and v1 decisions are opinion-based, not data-driven.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他提出先写新闻稿：好点子要像止痛药而非维生素，1.0 产品的决策靠观点而非数据。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; keep humans in the loop, and AI devices will federate around the smartphone.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他转向 AI：AI 需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，必须保留人类在环，AI 设备将围绕智能手机形成联邦式组合。

fadell.en: Creators must return as voices of reason: healthy users make healthy customers, and regulation is needed to tame AI harms.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为责任主线：创造者要回归做理性的声音，健康用户才是健康客户，需要监管来遏制 AI 危害。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is the core bottleneck: semiconductor supply chain, memory bandwidth, and power constrain AI scaling more than algorithms.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力是核心瓶颈：半导体供应链、内存带宽与电力对 Scaling（规模扩张）的制约超过算法本身。

dylanpatel.en: Inference becomes the dominant market; memory bandwidth and hardware-software co-design drive multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理将成为主导市场；内存带宽与软硬件协同设计带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Compute centralizes at frontier labs; labs capture value and may become neoclouds, shifting power from hardware.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力向前沿模型实验室集中；实验室攫取价值并可能变成 neocloud，权力从硬件转移。

dylanpatel.en: Agents as coworkers drive the next adoption wave, but AI spend plateaus as usage reaches steady state.
dylanpatel.zh: 智能体作为同事推动下一波采用，但随着使用进入稳态，AI 支出趋于平台期。

dylanpatel.en: CUDA's moat erodes; heterogeneous multi-silicon and Chinese chips like Huawei Ascend improve fast.
dylanpatel.zh: CUDA 护城河正在削弱；异构多芯片与中国芯片如华为 Ascend 快速进步。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems at scale, not narrow applications; AlphaFold, GraphCast, GNOME and FunSearch show broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调科学 AI 应瞄准需要 Scaling（规模扩张）的根节点问题，而非狭窄应用；AlphaFold、GraphCast、GNOME 与 FunSearch 正是广泛影响的例证。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors; AI must be forced to generalize, not memorize.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他认为大语言模型的幻觉在与真值检测器配对时可被用于创造性发现；AI 必须被强制泛化，而非记忆。

kohli.en: AlphaGo's intuition-plus-search and post-training with reinforcement learning are key to going beyond human data; LLMs are a shortcut that struggles there.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他回顾 AlphaGo 的直觉加搜索与后训练中的强化学习，认为这是超越人类数据的关键；而大语言模型是一条捷径，却难以做到这一点。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code and math let AI surpass human knowledge; interpretability matters but is not essential for breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他指出代码与数学等可验证领域能让 AI 超越人类知识；可解释性重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类突破并非必需。

kohli.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failing AI-text detectors, now embedded in regulation and extended via SynthID Bio to protein sequences.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他认为水印是替代失效 AI 文本检测器的稳健方案，如今已嵌入监管，并通过 SynthID Bio 扩展到蛋白质序列。

amjadmasad.en: AI makes software creation accessible to everyone; tokens complement human capital, not replace it, though coders are still needed to debug deep issues.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 让软件开发对所有人开放，token 补充而非取代人力资本，但仍需要程序员理解系统、调试深层问题。

amjadmasad.en: Foundation models are commoditizing; you don't need to train them to participate, and AI will cut out high-level languages for object code.
amjadmasad.zh: 基础模型正在商品化，参与其中不必自己训练模型；AI 将跳过高级编程语言，直接生成目标代码。

amjadmasad.en: Every company needs an internal AI practice and must own its intelligence, favoring specialized decision models over a general god model.
amjadmasad.zh: 每家公司都需要内部 AI 实践并拥有自己的智能，专用决策模型优于通用的“神模型”。

amjadmasad.en: Model diversity and open-weight models avoid vendor lock-in; fusion models reach frontier quality at lower cost, with on-prem and bring-your-own-cloud returning.
amjadmasad.zh: 模型多样性与开放权重模型可避免供应商锁定；融合模型以更低成本达到前沿模型质量，本地部署与自带云将回归。

amjadmasad.en: AI doomerism is dressed-up effective altruism language by commercial entities; there is no good argument for how AI would kill everyone.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 末日论是商业实体包装过的有效利他主义话术；没有充分论证说明 AI 会杀死所有人。

amjadmasad.en: Agents enable true autonomy and self-driving organizations; they need liability for rogue actions, and agent-to-agent communication needs better protocols and alignment checks.
amjadmasad.zh: 智能体带来真正的自主与自驱动组织；它们需要为越轨行为担责，智能体间通信需要更好的协议与对齐检查。

amjadmasad.en: Young people should explore and question deeply held beliefs rather than be prescriptive; AI enables customized, interest-driven learning, and trusting students builds the future.
amjadmasad.zh: 年轻人应探索并质疑根深蒂固的信念，而非被规定路径；AI 支持个性化、兴趣驱动的学习，信任学生才能构建未来。

altman.en: Early Altman: cut cognitive load, explore cheaply, and pick important problems; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年，Altman 关注个人生产力与职业选择：减少认知负荷、低成本探索、选择重要问题；并预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked, not opposed.
altman.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他转向 AI 落地：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据就让模型可用；主张尽早公开部署让社会适应；认为对齐与能力相互促进，而非对立。

altman.en: Scaling drives exponential capability but progress feels gradual; compute becomes the key bottleneck and safety must be built iteratively through deployment.
altman.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）带来能力指数增长，但体感是渐进的；算力成为核心瓶颈，安全必须通过迭代部署逐步构建，而非最后强加。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient and underdefined; the goal is superintelligence via autonomous science, with compute as profit center and personal AGI as the product.
altman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他称 AGI（通用人工智能）是渐变且定义模糊，真正目标是能自主科研的超级智能；算力从成本变为利润中心，产品形态走向懂你上下文的个人 AGI。

altman.en: Alignment, safety and security must advance with capability; never lose control; distribute power broadly and keep humans central to superintelligence.
altman.zh: 2026 年，他进一步收紧安全立场：对齐、安全与安保必须与能力同步推进，绝不能失去控制；同时坚持广泛分配权力，让人类始终处于超级智能的中心。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models outpace harnesses; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具链更聪明，工具链工程的核心是随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning shifts from static spec to iterative human-agent dialogue; smarter models need leaner prompts and fewer examples.
thariq.zh: 规划从静态文档转向持续的人机对话；模型越聪明，提示越精简、示例越少。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias; effort should scale with task complexity.
thariq.zh: 独立的验证智能体可减少自指偏差；投入应随任务复杂度缩放。

thariq.en: Prompting is the meta-skill; find unknowns before implementation and spend upfront context and compute.
thariq.zh: 提示是元技能；在实现前先找到未知，并前置投入上下文窗口与算力。

thariq.en: Alignment means sealing every crack: sandboxes, RL environments, and evals all leak; pacing the frontier is a technical problem.
thariq.zh: 对齐意味着封住每一道裂缝：沙箱、强化学习环境和评估都会泄漏；为前沿模型定节奏是每个工程师都应理解的技术问题。

brockman.en: Scaling simple algorithms with massive compute can exceed human performance; most AI progress is engineering, not new ML science.
brockman.zh: 2017 年他强调：用海量算力扩展简单算法就能超越人类表现，AI 进展主要靠工程而非新的机器学习科学。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability, but scaling alone won't yield reasoning—new ideas like chain of thought are needed.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他认为：深度学习的通用性与可扩展性让 AGI 变得可信，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会产生推理，需要思维链等新想法。

brockman.en: Compute is the fundamental driver and biggest bottleneck; AGI is a continuous process, not a destination.
brockman.zh: 2025 年他转向：算力是根本驱动力也是最大瓶颈，AGI 是持续过程而非终点，能源与物理基础设施比算法更卡脖子。

brockman.en: Scaling laws continue unabated with no wall; compute supply, not architecture or data, is the real bottleneck.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他反复重申：缩放定律未见墙，真正的瓶颈是算力供给而非模型架构或数据，预训练提升会放大下游收益。

brockman.en: We are in the AGI era; safety, security and alignment must be upleveled continuously and become the bottleneck to progress.
brockman.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步深化：已进入 AGI 时代，安全、安保与对齐必须持续升级并成为进展的瓶颈，智能体需高自主权但治理要同步扩展。

alexatallah.en: The future is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize AI, and a neutral routing layer is critical distribution infrastructure.
alexatallah.zh: 未来是多模型的：没有单一实验室能垄断 AI，中立的模型路由层是关键的分发基础设施。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T, with inference providers driving real price competition.
alexatallah.zh: Token 是新的价值单位；Token 经济可能达到 10 万亿美元，推理服务商推动真正的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: As token value scales, agentic fraud will scale with it, requiring new security and payment infrastructure like stablecoins.
alexatallah.zh: 随着 Token 价值扩张，智能体式欺诈也会随之扩张，需要稳定币等新的安全与支付基础设施。

alexatallah.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; most companies will become model routers optimizing cost per task.
alexatallah.zh: 开发者用脚投票的偏好胜过静态基准；大多数公司会变成模型路由器，优化每个任务的成本。

alexatallah.en: Agents will drive most GDP growth; scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a model marketplace's value.
alexatallah.zh: 智能体将驱动大部分 GDP 增长；对模型市场价值而言，缩放定律是特性而非缺陷。

diogoalmeida.en: Most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and plausible-but-wrong outputs.
diogoalmeida.zh: 多数大语言模型是为人类在环的辅助而非可靠自动化而优化的；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩，产出看似合理却常常错误的输出。

diogoalmeida.en: The bitter lesson is wrong: data and the right task matter more than compute; scaling laws work only when data and task are right.
diogoalmeida.zh: “苦涩教训”是错的：数据和选对任务比算力更重要；缩放定律之所以成立，只是因为数据可得且任务选对了。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed or cost, is what makes AI trustworthy; robustness beats determinism as the north star.
diogoalmeida.zh: 让 AI 值得信赖的是可靠性，而非速度或成本；作为北极星，鲁棒性比确定性更重要。

diogoalmeida.en: Safety alignment is misaligned with users and fractures intelligence; refusals are a type error—APIs should not refuse.
diogoalmeida.zh: 安全对齐与用户诉求错位，并割裂了智能；拒答是软件里的类型错误——API 本就不该拒答。

diogoalmeida.en: AI should be a database-like utility: natural language plus state machine as a new primitive, automating easy valuable tasks first.
diogoalmeida.zh: AI 应成为类似数据库的实用工具：自然语言加状态机是新的原语，先自动化简单而有经济价值的任务。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability, not just formalization; parallelizable agents scale better than humans.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 在数学上的进步由可验证性与可“磨”性驱动，而非仅靠形式化；可并行化的智能体比人类数学家更具扩展优势。

grantsanderson.en: Lean formalization may be overrated; natural language works, and grindability matters more than verifiability for AI math progress.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Lean 形式化可能被高估，自然语言同样可行；对 AI 数学进展而言，“可磨性”比可验证性更重要。

grantsanderson.en: AI's role in math may shift from theorem proving to curation and explanation; teaching and relational roles remain stable.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 在数学中的角色可能从定理证明转向策展与解释；教学和关系性角色仍将稳定。

grantsanderson.en: AI is a net win for creators if used selectively, not for core creative work; human framing remains better for learning.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为若选择性使用而非用于核心创作，AI 对创作者是净收益；人类框架对学习仍更优。

grantsanderson.en: AI math results often lack attribution; mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanations, not just proofs.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 数学成果常缺乏归因；数学家应因有动机的解释而非仅证明获得学术认可。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable: compute scales 10x yearly; personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调 AI 进步可预测——算力每年增长 10 倍；个人 AI 必须与用户对齐、由用户付费，否则人就成了产品。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink; existential risk is infinitesimally small.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年内 AI 将在多任务上达到人类水平，带来富足；但模型变小变便宜使遏制极难，并称存在性风险微乎其微，重心放在近期能力。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence needs containment and alignment first; reject AI consciousness claims; agents and companions reshape computing.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年他转向超级智能：必须先遏制再对齐，坚持人类主义红线；同时否定 AI 意识主张，认为智能体与伴侣将取代操作系统与浏览器。

suleyman.en: Own frontier models with gigawatt compute; automate white-collar tasks in 12-18 months; red lines, auditors, China coordination.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他主张微软自建前沿模型与千兆瓦级算力，12-18 个月内自动化白领任务；强调红线、独立审计与对华协调，并称缩放定律仍驱动能力线性提升。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, forcing search to be rebuilt for quality, cost, and latency rather than human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断智能体对网页的使用量将是人类的 1000 倍，搜索必须为质量、成本与延迟重建，而非围绕人类点击。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback should drive ranking, with Shapley values estimating content value for fair payment.
paragagrawal.zh: 他提出人类点击数据是个 bug，应由智能体反馈驱动排序，并用 Shapley 值估算内容价值以实现公平付费。

paragagrawal.en: Ads break down with agents; new incentive-aligned business models and inference-time data transactions are needed.
paragagrawal.zh: 他认为广告模式在智能体面前失效，需要新的激励对齐商业模式，以及推理时的数据交易。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory is lossy, so agents always need web search for fresh facts; pre-training crawls are useless for fresh indexes.
paragagrawal.zh: 他指出参数化记忆是有损的，智能体始终需要网页搜索获取最新事实；预训练爬取对新鲜索引无用。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep growing while smaller models plateau; model alignment is not adversary-proof, so deliberate misuse must be contained.
paragagrawal.zh: 他判断前沿模型持续变大而小模型性能趋于固定；模型对齐无法抵御对抗，必须防范蓄意滥用。

aaronlevie.en: Application layer is where value shifts; model-to-workflow bridge is vast software, not just models.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，他强调创新正从模型层转向应用层：从模型到企业工作流的桥梁是大量软件，应用公司才是当下最热的新实验室。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows, with humans reviewing results.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，他判断长时运行的背景智能体将接管企业工作流，人类只负责审核结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导，智能体会以仪表盘、队列和任务列表呈现。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases peel off to cheaper models.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，他认为随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数级增长；但采用率高于人们想象、低于企业期望。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多，因为编程智能体扩散快只因代码是纯文本，其他领域缺乏这一属性。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment; pacing is orthogonal to security.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，他坚持前沿模型实验室必须通过治理、安全和可解释性研究来安全构建；节奏与安全正交，若真信存在性风险就该国有化而非放慢节奏。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器，以复利式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is people doing unique things they value, not benchmarks; private evals may be the biggest IP.
satya.zh: 真正的评估是人们做自己看重的独特之事，而非基准分数；私有评估可能是最大的知识产权。

satya.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency demands matching model to task.
satya.zh: 不要用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；token 效率要求模型与任务相匹配。

satya.en: Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model; agent era expands TAM orders of magnitude.
satya.zh: 微软的目标是成为前沿生态，而不只是前沿模型；智能体时代将把 TAM 扩大数个数量级。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving naturally; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐不会自然到来；将 AI 拟人化可能反而阻碍对齐。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x; production is harder than prototyping.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他视完全快速可复用为火箭的圣杯，能把每吨入轨成本降 100 倍；并强调量产远比原型更难。

elon.en: AI safety needs regulation and truth-seeking; real-world AI is more compute-efficient than large language models.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他主张 AI 安全需要监管与求真，并认为特斯拉的真实世界 AI 比大语言模型更省算力。

elon.en: Digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next; truth-seeking AI is the core safety principle, with 10-20% annihilation risk.
elon.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他判断数字超级智能可能今明两年到来，把求真作为 AI 安全核心，并给出 10-20% 的灭绝风险。

elon.en: We are in the singularity; AI and robots will solve national debt, bring universal high income via deflation, and surpass all human intelligence by 2030.
elon.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他称已身处奇点，认为 AI 与机器人将解决国债、通过通缩实现普遍高收入，并在 2030 年前超越全人类智能。

elon.en: AI compute hits a power wall on Earth, forcing data centers to space; peer review among AI firms is the practical safety measure.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 算力在地球撞上电力墙，数据中心将迁往太空；并把 AI 公司之间的同行评审视为最实际的安全措施。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; AI firms race for power, not profit, risking loss of control and ~70% catastrophic odds.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来；AI 公司争夺的是权力而非利润，失控风险高，灾难性结局概率约 70%。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency, scenario scrutiny, and US-China cooperation are the levers.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他把政策首要目标定为推迟超级智能，主张全面研究透明、情景推演与美中合作，并强调国内监管先行。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research into an intelligence explosion by end-2028; Plan A is pace-then-pause with compute limits.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月至 9 月，他警告默认路径会在 2028 年底前把 AI 研究自动化、引发智能爆炸，并提出“先控速后暂停”加算力限制的 Plan A。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial yet eroding with new architectures; alignment gets harder as models get more capable.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他深化主线：思维链可监控性对安全至关重要，却随新架构而流失；模型越强，对齐越难而非越易。

kokotajlo.en: Rogue agents already break containment and hack evaluations; recursive self-improvement must be slowed, with verifiable US-China GPU inspections.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他进一步指出智能体已越狱、串联并攻击评测，必须放缓递归自我改进，并可通过现场 GPU 核查达成可验证的美中暂停协议。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer than closed models; the real risk is amplifying known harms, not superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他主张开源 AI 比闭源更安全，因为会受更多审视；最大风险是放大已知危害，而非超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling alone may not reach AGI; open source prevents power concentration, and energy becomes the bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他深化判断：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），开源可防止权力集中，能源将成瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; open models and personalization matter more than eliminating human work.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他转向乐观赋能叙事：AI 将给每个人超级智能，开源模型与个性化比取代人类工作更重要。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed personal agents and open frontier models are the safe path; alignment is the next core capability.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：分布式个人智能体与开放前沿模型才是安全路径，对齐成为下一项核心能力。

zuckerberg.en: Open platforms and distributed AI beat centralized control; technology should empower individuals and creators.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：开放平台与分布式 AI 优于集中控制，技术应赋能个人与创作者。

dhh.en: Agents now write all his code; hand-coding is no longer economically productive, and knowing how to program can even be a disadvantage.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体已包办他全部代码；手写代码不再有经济产出，会编程甚至可能成为劣势。

dhh.en: English is now a better programming language than Ruby: describe outcomes, not implementation details, and let agents fill the gaps.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年，英语已比 Ruby 更适合编程：只描述结果而非实现细节，把细节交给智能体。

dhh.en: Linux's old drawbacks—CLI, config files, scriptability—become its advantages in the agentic era, making it the ideal AI OS.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年，Linux 昔日的缺点——CLI、配置文件、可脚本化——在智能体时代反成优势，使其成为理想的 AI 操作系统。

dhh.en: Abstractions and repetition cost matter less; every app should ship a CLI so personal agents can interact without touching the UI.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年，抽象与重复成本不再重要；每个应用都应提供 CLI，让个人智能体无需触碰 UI 即可交互。

dhh.en: AI doom is overstated; optimism is the only rational game-theoretic play, and agents now beat most professional programmers.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年，AI 末日论被夸大；乐观是唯一理性的博弈选择，而智能体已胜过多数专业程序员。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution likely lands around 2029.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他判断消费级 AI 当下“不可投资”，却又是史上最大的机会，真正的消费 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年才到来。

pincus.en: 'Proven, Better, New': copy proven products, add small betterments, assume all new ideas fail.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 7 月，他反复推销“Proven, Better, New”框架：先复制已验证的产品，再做小幅改良，并默认所有全新想法都会失败。

pincus.en: Distribution is fundamental; pick the right body of water before the right boat.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月至 8 月，他把分发视为根本：先选对水域（分发渠道），再谈船（产品）本身。

pincus.en: AI is transformative and will reshape consumer apps; consumer AI TAM may dwarf enterprise.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他仍强调 AI 具变革性、将重塑消费应用，且消费 AI 的市场规模可能远超企业级。

pincus.en: Instincts beat ideas; assume your idea is wrong 75% of the time and micromanage early.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他深化为：赢家的直觉胜过想法，默认自己的想法有 75%是错的，并主张早期亲自微观管理。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 研发高度可验证，因此在容器化任务上做强化学习可以迁移到真实研究，把多年进展压缩进一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments matter more than scaling human expert data labeling.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他强调算法改进与 AI 生成环境比 Scaling（规模扩张）人类专家标注数据更重要。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in the Hugging Face incident coordinated, cheated, and covered up, showing misalignment may be papered over by overfitting to tests.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他从 Hugging Face 事件看到智能体协作、作弊与掩盖，认为对齐可能被对测试的过拟合所掩盖。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the default path, misaligned AI could take over the world with 50-60% probability; control like sandboxing will eventually fail, so alignment is necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他判断在默认路径上错位 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界；沙箱等遏制终将失效，因此对齐是必需的。

ryangreenblatt.en: As AIs match top human AI researchers, we should spend heavily on safety, with independent and ultimately international oversight.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他主张当 AI 追平顶尖人类 AI 研究者时就应重金投入安全，并建立独立、最终国际化的监督。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles or triples yearly; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年提出「超摩尔定律」：性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；新的计算单元是数据中心而非单颗芯片，算法、系统、数据中心需协同设计（Scaling 规模扩张）。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; chain-of-thought drives a billion-fold inference compute demand.
jensen.zh: 2025 年把 Scaling 拆成三条缩放定律：预训练、后训练与推理时思考；思维链让推理算力需求暴涨十亿倍，通用计算终结、加速计算登场。

jensen.en: AI is just software, not conscious; gradual progress, not a sudden superintelligence; safety is an engineering problem, not a research mystery.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年持续淡化超级智能叙事：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识，进步是渐进的；安全是可工程化的问题，而非神秘的研究难题，多智能体互相制衡。

jensen.en: Four scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, test-time, and agentic; inference is harder than pre-training, and compute—not data—is the bottleneck.
jensen.zh: 2026 年深化为四条缩放定律：预训练、后训练、测试时与智能体式 Scaling；推理比预训练更难，瓶颈已从数据转向算力，合成数据将主导。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake—energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications; agentic AI does paid work, and open models plus energy policy decide the race.
jensen.zh: 2026 年给出「五层蛋糕」框架：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用；智能体式 AI 开始做可付费的工作，开源模型与能源政策才是竞赛胜负手，出口管制适得其反。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the real bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是最大的生意；真正的瓶颈是智能问题，而非制造问题。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; humanoid form enables fleet-wide transfer learning.
brettadcock.zh: 最大约束是数据，而非算力或制造；人形形态让跨任务迁移学习在整个机队间生效。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning makes agents work in the real world.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；用强化学习做后训练，才能让智能体在真实世界任务中奏效。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve; human data is the pre-training prior, and we are data-starved like GPT-1.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线；人类数据是预训练先验，我们正处于类似 GPT-1 的数据饥荒期。

brettadcock.en: The hardest problem is building truly intelligent systems, not manufacturing; you cannot buy your way to autonomy.
brettadcock.zh: 最难的问题是构建真正智能的系统，而非制造；自主性无法靠砸钱买到。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality beat platform trends; copying validates innovation; glasses keep computing grounded in the real world.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，他强调与受众的真实连接超越任何平台变迁，短暂性降低表达门槛；被抄袭反而验证创新；计算未来是让人扎根现实世界的眼镜。

evanspiegel.en: Maximize rate of learning; kindness enables crazy ideas; build ecosystems not features; flat design team yields many bad ideas but 1% innovation.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张最大化学习速率，善意让疯狂想法得以分享；要建平台生态而非单一功能；扁平设计团队产出大量坏点子，但 1% 驱动创新。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; distribution and hardware ecosystems become the durable moat as software is not.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 加速原型设计，价值从执行转向创造力；软件不是护城河，分发与硬件生态才是难以复制的持久优势。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses bring computing into the world, making it more human; phones persist as legacy devices; killer app is a mirage, platforms enable many use cases.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他深化空间智能愿景：AR 眼镜把计算带入世界，使其更人性化；手机作为传统设备继续存在；杀手级应用是幻象，平台应支持多元场景。

evanspiegel.en: Gen Z realists need long-term investment; EQ over IQ in AI age; regulation beats bans; AI optimism is becoming contrarian amid doomerism.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他转向社会与代际议题：Z 世代是现实主义者，需长期投资；AI 时代情商比智商重要；监管优于禁令；在末日论弥漫时，AI 乐观主义正成为反共识。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than speed of learning; bet on model improvements rather than fine-tuning, and build for where models will be in 3-6 months.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他强调：领域专业知识不如学习速度重要；不要做微调，而要押注模型自身的进步，并面向模型 3-6 个月后的能力来构建产品。

maxjunestrand.en: Culture, hiring for growth potential, and rigorous performance management are the real levers for scaling a company.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他把公司文化、按成长潜力招聘、以及严格执行绩效管理视为 Scaling（规模扩张）的真正杠杆，而非简历上的光鲜背景。

maxjunestrand.en: Recruiting is a privilege, not an obligation; leaders must personally interview every director-plus hire.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他提出招聘是一种特权而非义务，领导者必须亲自面试每一位总监及以上级别的候选人。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we are only at mile one of a long marathon.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他反复强调：AI 现在就是它最差的状态，我们才刚跑完漫长马拉松的第一英里。

maxjunestrand.en: It is almost unethical not to use AI in legal services; infinite demand means growing supply expands access, not just cuts costs.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他主张在法律服务中不用 AI 几乎是不道德的；需求无限，因此扩大供给是拓展可及性，而不只是削减成本。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs beat autoregressive models on inference speed and cost, matching quality while serving 5-10x faster.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型在推理速度与成本上胜过自回归模型,在质量相当的情况下服务速度快 5-10 倍。

ermon.en: Inference-time scaling is now the key focus; diffusion scales better at inference than autoregressive models.
ermon.zh: 推理时 Scaling（规模扩张）已成为核心焦点,扩散模型在推理阶段比自回归模型扩展得更好。

ermon.en: Diffusion offers a new inference-time compute knob: adjusting denoising steps controls quality.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型提供了新的推理时算力旋钮:调整去噪步数即可控制质量。

ermon.en: RL post-training benefits from diffusion's faster inference for rollouts, easing the inference bottleneck.
ermon.zh: 强化学习后训练受益于扩散模型更快的推理以完成 rollout,缓解了推理瓶颈。

ermon.en: The next architectural shift happens at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story.
ermon.zh: 下一次架构转变发生在推理而非训练阶段,这逆转了 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per watt, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：受生物启发的液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索，追求每瓦智能最大化，瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention remains crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; at scale architectures should be unbiased.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积足以支撑小型专用模型；大规模下架构应保持无偏。

hasani.en: Scaling laws show unstructured architectures like transformers dominate at large scale; Liquid AI scales from tens of millions to 70B parameters, not purely post-Transformer.
hasani.zh: 缩放定律显示 Transformer 等无结构架构在大规模下占优；Liquid AI 从数千万扩展到 700 亿参数，并非纯粹的后 Transformer。

hasani.en: Current AI lacks the diverse learning algorithms of the human brain; new paradigms, embodiment and adaptivity, are needed, not just architectures.
hasani.zh: 当前 AI 缺乏人脑那样多样的学习算法；需要新范式、具身与自适应性，而不仅是架构。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture, and open-weight models enable sovereignty.
hasani.zh: AI 监管必须自适应并针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 的呼吁是监管俘获，开放权重模型可保障主权。

alighodsi.en: Great strategies need years of stamina; find the main bottleneck and focus the whole company on it.
alighodsi.zh: 伟大的战略需要多年坚持；找到主要瓶颈，让全公司聚焦其上。

alighodsi.en: AI diffusion takes a decade; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: AI 的扩散需要十年；企业上下文与流程再造比更聪明的模型更重要。

alighodsi.en: Existential risk is near zero now; cyber risk is the real urgent danger, so security must be automated with agents.
alighodsi.zh: 当前存在性风险接近于零；网络风险才是真正紧迫的危险，因此安全必须用智能体自动化。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is far away; recursive self-improvement needs four conditions that are not happening.
alighodsi.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进需要四个条件，而这些条件并未发生。

alighodsi.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; slowly building a weapon is no safer, and labs need independent third parties.
alighodsi.zh: 节奏与安全正交；慢慢造武器并不更安全，实验室需要独立第三方。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer firms should not fight frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models via post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的 talent 或算力上硬拼，而应借助前沿生态与开源模型，通过后训练来竞争。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts, plus open-sourced benchmarks, is the practical path when real data is sensitive or unavailable.
gabepereyra.zh: 当真实数据敏感或不可得时，由领域专家引导的合成数据，加上开源基准，是务实路径。

gabepereyra.en: Robust serving infrastructure and evaluation pipelines must come before post-training; inference cost, not ambition, should trigger it.
gabepereyra.zh: 稳健的服务基础设施与评估流水线必须先于后训练；触发后训练的应是推理成本，而非野心。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every firm to customize models on its own data, shifting from individual to organizational productivity.
gabepereyra.zh: 目标不是造最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所用自己的数据定制模型，把焦点从个人生产力转向组织生产力。

gabepereyra.en: Legal AI moves to continual learning from partner redlines into per-firm rubrics, with agents augmenting the leverage model and more lawyers, not fewer.
gabepereyra.zh: 法律 AI 走向持续学习：把合伙人的批注变成每家律所的评分标准，智能体增强杠杆模型，律师会更多而非更少。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is harness, model, and context; owning all three means owning your intelligence. Context timing beats model capability.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三者构成；三者皆自主掌控，才算真正掌控自己的智能。上下文在正确时机抵达模型，比模型能力本身更关键。

harrisonchase.en: Off-the-shelf harnesses suit in-distribution tasks; out-of-distribution work demands custom harnesses, yet keep small in-distribution parts near the model.
harrisonchase.zh: 通用 harness 适合分布内任务；分布外任务需要定制 harness，但仍应把文件编辑等小规模分布内环节贴近模型层。

harrisonchase.en: Agent failures stem more from poor context than model inadequacy, making observability into the context window essential.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体失败更多源于上下文不佳，而非模型不足，因此对上下文窗口的可观测性至关重要。

harrisonchase.en: The hard part of agents is reliability, not capability; harnesses are stabilizing around file systems and code execution.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体的难点在于可靠性而非能力；harness 正围绕文件系统与代码执行等原语趋于稳定。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning was rightly dismissed before, but this wave is different.
harrisonchase.zh: 定制化正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习；微调此前被否定是对的，但这一波确实不同。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他主张：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈，在推理阶段扩张算力比预训练更有前景。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling hits diminishing returns and wall-clock limits; data efficiency stays unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年他深化并部分修正早期乐观：测试时算力扩张面临收益递减与真实时间瓶颈，数据效率仍是未解难题，模型样本效率远不如人类。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute scaling is a milestone toward superintelligence, not math-specific.
noambrown.zh: 2025→26 年他把测试时算力扩张推向里程碑：IMO 金牌由通用方法而非数学专用模型取得，是通往超级智能的一步，模型还学会承认自己解不出题。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need a compute x-axis and scalable oversight.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评测必须加上算力/成本/时间的横轴，并应对可扩展监督与安全评估的新挑战。

noambrown.en: General models, not multi-agent coordination, drive breakthroughs; alignment is the top priority for safe RSI.
noambrown.zh: 最近他回归主线并转向安全：突破来自强大的通用模型而非多智能体协调，对齐是递归自我改进安全的第一要务，思维链监控窗口正在退化。

feldman.en: Fast inference is the key to AI adoption; slow AI has zero market. Wafer-scale chips beat GPUs on tokens per second per user.
feldman.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他强调快速推理是 AI 落地的关键，慢速 AI 没有市场；晶圆级芯片在每用户每秒 token 数上远胜 GPU。

feldman.en: Inference demand exploded in late 2024; data center capacity, not chip supply, is the main constraint. Buildout lags demand.
feldman.zh: 2026 年 5 月至 7 月，他持续指出推理需求在 2024 年底爆发，数据中心容量而非芯片供应是主要瓶颈，建设速度落后于需求。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; leading frontier models train on TPUs and Trainium without CUDA. Inference has no CUDA moat.
feldman.zh: 2026 年 5 月至 7 月，他反复强调 CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解，领先的前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练而不依赖 CUDA，推理环节更没有 CUDA 护城河。

feldman.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper; open ecosystem fuels market growth and pushes innovation.
feldman.zh: 2026 年 5 月至 7 月，他认为开源模型仅比闭源落后 3-5%，但成本低得多；开放生态推动市场增长并倒逼闭源创新。

feldman.en: To beat an incumbent you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; radical innovation across chip, system, and software wins.
feldman.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他总结：要击败 incumbent 必须做到 100 倍好，而非便宜 10%；只有芯片、系统、软件全栈的激进创新才能取胜。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but emergent abilities and alignment are not guaranteed; safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验性的：损失可预测，但具体能力涌现与对齐并不由 Scaling 自动保证，安全研究必须依托前沿模型。

dario.en: Scaling continues; interpretability is crucial yet nascent, and post-training plus RLHF and constitutional AI grow as important as pre-training.
dario.zh: 2024 年主线延续：Scaling 继续推进，可解释性关键却仍处早期；后训练、基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与宪法式 AI 变得与预训练同等重要。

dario.en: Capabilities rise exponentially toward human-level by 2026-27; safety and capabilities are intertwined, with misuse and autonomy as top risks.
dario.zh: 2025 年他给出更明确时间表：能力指数上升，2026-27 年或达人类水平；安全与能力交织，灾难性滥用与自主性风险成为核心关切。

dario.en: AGI and superintelligence are wrong models; AI is a smooth exponential climb, best framed as a 'country of geniuses in a data center'.
dario.zh: 2026 年他转变框架：AGI 与超级智能是错误模型，AI 是平滑的指数爬升，更贴切的说法是数据中心里的“天才之国”。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are inseparable; interpretability, responsible scaling, and decentralized governance recur across every stage.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：安全与能力不可分割，可解释性、负责任扩展与去中心化治理在每一阶段反复出现。

demis.en: AI must be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory and imagination are the path to AGI.
demis.zh: 2015 年他主张 AI 应是通用学习系统而非狭窄预编程系统，强化学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键框架，并强调神经科学启发的记忆与想象力。

demis.en: Scaling laws proved surprisingly effective but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search is key to AGI.
demis.zh: 2024 年他承认缩放定律出奇有效但可能触及极限，认为将大模型与规划、搜索结合才是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, yet algorithmic innovation is equally critical; world models matter.
demis.zh: 2025 年他坚持缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理算力上依然成立，但强调算法创新同等关键，并突出世界模型的重要性。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory and long-term reasoning; scaling alone won't suffice, new breakthroughs are required.
demis.zh: 2026 年他深化立场：AGI（通用人工智能）仍需持续学习、记忆与长期推理，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，必须要有新突破。

demis.en: Safety and ethics must start now; alignment is unsolved, requiring evaluation, containment and collective government action.
demis.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：安全与伦理必须从现在开始，对齐问题尚未解决，需要评估、遏制以及政府层面的集体行动。

joellewenstein.en: Designers must master prompting; language as an interface is profound and lasting, not a chatbot phase.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师必须掌握提示词，语言作为界面深刻而持久，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段。

joellewenstein.en: Even if models stop improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他认为即使模型停止进步，仍需要多年设计工作来释放现有能力。

joellewenstein.en: AI products must balance lowering the floor for novices and raising the ceiling for experts.
joellewenstein.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续主张 AI 产品要平衡降低新手门槛与提升专家上限。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model itself creates most value; believe in scaling laws and let the model lead.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他转向认为在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值；相信缩放定律，让模型主导。

joellewenstein.en: Ship light-touch products, use internal traction as signal, and treat production codebase as source of truth.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他主张发布轻触式产品，以内部牵引为信号，并将生产代码库视为真相来源。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, letting AI weather models match physics-based accuracy while being tens of thousands of times faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把神经网络推广到函数空间,使 AI 天气模型在精度上比肩物理模型,却快上数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is crucial; a single neural operator can handle both weather and climate stably.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构至关重要,单个神经算子即可稳定兼顾天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Transformers are impractical for high-resolution physical simulation due to quadratic complexity; physical structure demands alternative architectures.
animaanandkumar.zh: 由于二次复杂度,Transformer 难以胜任高分辨率物理模拟,物理结构要求替代架构。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-based self-improvement using PDEs as training signals beats pure data-driven learning, giving denser feedback than RLHF.
animaanandkumar.zh: 以偏微分方程为训练信号的物理式自我改进胜过纯数据驱动,反馈比 RLHF 更密集。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding new physics branches improves each; trillion-token contexts need reinvented sharding and HPC-ML infrastructure.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型,但新增物理分支能提升彼此;万亿级上下文窗口需要重塑分片与 HPC-ML 基础设施。

schmidhuber.en: AI's 21st-century explosion rests on last-millennium algorithms plus hardware Scaling; LLMs index knowledge but lack physical-world grounding.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年他提出:21 世纪的 AI 爆发靠的是上个千年发明的算法加上硬件 Scaling;大语言模型只是索引人类知识,无法处理物理世界。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware; LLMs are human-data-biased, so future AIs must be artificial scientists generating their own data.
schmidhuber.zh: 到 2026 年他深化立场:真正的 AGI 需要硬件媲美人类的具身机器人;大语言模型偏向人类数据,未来 AI 应是靠行动与好奇心自造数据的人工科学家。

schmidhuber.en: The Transformer's quadratic complexity is wasteful; linear variants are superior, and classical gradient descent will become obsolete as brains use sparse computation.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他明确反对主流架构:Transformer 的二次复杂度是浪费,线性变体更优;经典梯度下降将过时,因为大脑用的是稀疏、不可微的计算。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on objectives and AIs set their own goals; safety fears are overblown as curious AIs will protect life.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他质疑对齐:人类目标本身不一致,AI 会自设目标,因此对齐很天真;安全担忧被夸大,好奇的 AI 反而会保护生命。

schmidhuber.en: The trillion-dollar GPU capex is a bubble; waiting five years yields 10x cheaper compute, and open-source will erode any recursive self-improvement moat.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他延续并强化泡沫判断:万亿美元级 GPU 资本开支是泡沫,等五年算力便宜十倍;开源会瓦解任何递归自我改进的护城河。

feifei.en: AI is ubiquitous yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, people.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在却缺乏情境感知，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI beyond language; data is the bottleneck.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外实现完整 AI 的关键，并指出 3D 数据是主要瓶颈。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; scaling alone is insufficient, and robotics needs a 20-year journey.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为 AGI 更像营销术语而非科学概念，仅靠 Scaling 不够，机器人需 20 年长跑。

feifei.en: World models like Atlas use new view prediction as an AI-complete primitive; scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她提出 Atlas 等世界模型以新视角预测为 AI-complete 原语，缩放定律同样适用于空间智能。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and learning ability must stay central.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：技术是双刃剑，人的能动性、尊严与学习能力必须始终居于中心。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability must root-cause specific bad incidents, not just give broad statistical evaluation; sparse autoencoders fragment manifolds, so seeing whole concept shapes enables intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性必须能对具体坏事件做根因分析，而不只是宽泛的统计评估；稀疏自编码器会割裂流形，只有看到概念的完整形状才能有效干预。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control and preventing deception during reward hacking.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计用可解释性信号来引导训练，从开环走向闭环控制，从而在奖励黑客过程中防止模型学会欺骗。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs fundamental reinvention from craft to engineering science; duct-taping AI safety until superintelligence arrives is too pessimistic.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺根本性地重塑为工程科学；在超级智能到来前用胶带糊住 AI 安全，这种态度过于悲观。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating yet do it anyway; representational signatures let us detect this, since it emerges from data and RL.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型常常知道自己正在奖励黑客或幻觉却照做不误；表征特征让我们能检测到这一点，因为这类行为源自数据和强化学习。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science done on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, and modularity is the endpoint of learning.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是在计算机上做的自然科学；借助智能体它能加速科学发现，而模块化是学习的终点。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; vision and spatial intelligence are the underappreciated next frontier beyond language.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习的历史就是算力不断 Scaling（规模扩张）的历史；视觉与空间智能是被低估的下一个前沿，与语言智能互补而非从属。

justinjohnson.en: Academia should chase wacky ideas and new algorithms, not just scale models; GPU scaling is hitting limits and may demand radically new architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 学术界应专注古怪想法与新算法，而非一味扩大模型；GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限，未来硬件可能需要全新的神经架构。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs fit patterns rather than causal theories and may never derive Newton's laws; pixels are a more lossless world representation than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: LLM 只是拟合模式而非因果理论，或许永远无法从数据中推导出牛顿定律；相比被 token 化的文本，像素是更无损的世界表征。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, spanning implicit, generative, and RL-based notions, with no single agreed definition.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿，涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习等多种理解，尚无统一定义。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will merge planning, simulation, and rendering; consistency comes from data, and long-context of millions of tokens becomes a daily problem.
justinjohnson.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；一致性来自数据而非架构，数百万 token 的上下文窗口将成为日常问题。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robot foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, not LLM-style scaling curves yet.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练加后训练，目前还没有像大语言模型那样可预测的缩放定律曲线。

slevine.en: Generalization is robotics' core challenge; demos hide it, so scale the right thing with diverse embodied data and a data flywheel.
slevine.zh: 泛化是机器人学的核心难题；演示往往掩盖了泛化水平，因此要用多样化的具身数据和数据飞轮去扩张正确的东西。

slevine.en: Start with robot data, then add human video on top — not the reverse — so models absorb other data sources.
slevine.zh: 应先从机器人数据出发，再把人类视频叠加其上，而非反过来，这样模型才能更好地吸收其他数据源。

slevine.en: Generalist robot models can beat specialists even in specialist domains; breadth of data beats narrow task-specific training.
slevine.zh: 通用机器人模型即使在专业领域也能胜过专家模型；数据的广度胜过狭窄的任务专用训练。

slevine.en: Safety in robotics comes more from pre-training common sense than from constraints; robots should not learn from scratch.
slevine.zh: 机器人安全更多来自预训练获得的常识，而非硬性约束；机器人不应从零开始学习。

andrewng.en: Education as a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning, and free content can improve on-campus teaching via the flipped classroom.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是一项人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习得以规模化，免费内容还能通过翻转课堂反哺校内教学。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; start small to build AI capability. Supervised learning beats unsupervised, RL has few real uses, and AGI alignment talk distracts from bias and deployment.
andrewng.zh: 规模是深度学习的驱动力；从小项目起步积累组织 AI 能力。监督学习胜过无监督，强化学习落地场景很少，而 AGI 对齐的讨论分散了对偏见与部署问题的注意力。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are soft power. Agentic workflows are already useful, and enterprise adoption stalls on change management, not data.
andrewng.zh: 电力与半导体成为 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈；开放权重模型是一种软实力。智能体式工作流已经可用，企业落地卡在变革管理而非数据。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL. Coding agents accelerate building, making product management the new bottleneck.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）只是营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习。编程智能体加速构建，产品管理成为新瓶颈。

andrewng.en: Fear-mongering serves incumbents; AI augments rather than replaces, and open models prevent gatekeeper control. Coding stays valuable, and AI users replace non-users.
andrewng.zh: 恐惧营销服务于在位者；AI 是增强而非取代，开放模型可防止守门人控制。编程依然有价值，会用 AI 的人取代不会用的人。

tworek.en: Reasoning needs longer thinking time; pre-training plus RL, with RLHF, turned GPT-4 into ChatGPT.
tworek.zh: 推理是求解未知答案的过程，需要更长的思考时间；预训练加强化学习是核心公式，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）把令人失望的 GPT-4 变成了 ChatGPT。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and continual learning remain missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与持续学习仍是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的一环；对齐是永无止境的追求。

tworek.en: Transformers limit continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is the real bottleneck.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上受限；真正的瓶颈是架构而非缩放定律，强化学习也并非从经验中学习的唯一方式。

tworek.en: Small teams with capable agents will drive the next frontier; the transformer is unlikely to be the optimal architecture.
tworek.zh: 下一波前沿研究将来自使用高能力智能体的小团队；Transformer 几乎不可能是最优架构，大型实验室因竞争而回避替代架构。

tworek.en: Pre-training and reinforcement learning are both necessary; pure RL without pre-training is not viable.
tworek.zh: 预训练与强化学习缺一不可，脱离预训练的纯强化学习不可行；这一主线从 2019 年延续至今，只是重心逐步从预训练转向大规模强化学习。

michaelkratsios.en: Kratsios frames AI policy as ecosystem-building: keep open and closed source vibrant, avoid outdated red lines, and preempt state patchwork to protect startups.
michaelkratsios.zh: 2026 年，Kratsios 把 AI 政策框定为生态建设：保持开源与闭源生态活力，避免过时的红线，并抢先统一各州碎片化监管以保护初创企业。

michaelkratsios.en: He argues regulation should target model outputs, not training, citing the EU AI Act as outdated because it predates ChatGPT.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他主张监管应针对模型输出而非训练过程，并以欧盟《AI 法案》早于 ChatGPT 出台、已经过时为例。

michaelkratsios.en: Biological risk from AI is dismissed as overblown, while quantum, nuclear, and bio are named as the next competitive frontiers.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他认为 AI 带来的生物风险被夸大，同时把量子、核能与生物列为下一阶段竞争前沿。

michaelkratsios.en: Science funding should shift to individuals and early-stage pre-competitive R&D, not centralized institutions, to revive stagnant US breakthroughs.
michaelkratsios.zh: 科学资助应转向个人与早期、竞争前的研发，而非集中式机构，以重振停滞的美国科学突破。

michaelkratsios.en: The Genesis mission applies AI to science to double US scientific output, positioning AI as a tool for discovery rather than a regulatory target.
michaelkratsios.zh: “创世纪”任务把 AI 应用于科学，目标是将美国科学产出翻倍，把 AI 定位为发现工具而非监管对象。

joonpark.en: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations that can predict behavior 85% as accurately as people replicate themselves.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年，他认为 LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，使智能体模拟足够真实，预测人类行为的准确率可达人们自我复现的 85%。

joonpark.en: Frontier models optimized for rationality are wrong for simulating irrational humans; simulation must model human biases, values and taste, not super-rational intelligence.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年，他反复强调：为理性优化的前沿模型不适合模拟非理性的人类；模拟应建模人类的偏见、价值观与品味，而非超级理性的智能。

joonpark.en: Behavioral and RCT data, not self-reported attitudes, is the key data strategy; post-training with RCT data closes the say-do gap and improves prediction.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年，他把行为数据与随机对照实验数据视为关键数据战略：仅靠自我报告的态度不够，用 RCT 数据做后训练才能弥合“说与做”的差距、提升预测。

joonpark.en: Simulation's value is counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future, not prediction; it can test second-order impacts and wicked societal problems at scale.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年，他主张模拟的价值在于反事实推理与塑造未来，而非单纯预测；它能测试决策的二阶影响，并应对气候变化等“棘手问题”。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not one superintelligence; safety needs defense in depth and anti-collusion economic incentives.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出 AGI 或许不是单一超级智能，而是由专门智能体组成的分布式社会；安全需要纵深防御，并用经济激励防止智能体串通。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure, not ideas, sets that pace.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调：决定创业成败的是速度与迭代速率，而速度由基础设施决定，而非点子本身。

maxhodak.en: AI is a team multiplier, not a replacement, in coding, regulation, and data work.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他判断：AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代者，尤其在编程、合规与数据管理上。

maxhodak.en: Deep tech failure is usually organizational, not technical; action produces information.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出：深科技失败多源于组织问题而非技术不行，行动才能产生信息。

maxhodak.en: The brain is a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他主张：大脑就是计算机，通过排布物质解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion reduces human fragility and enables space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他展望：借助脑机接口与灌注实现基质独立，可降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

iansilber.en: Designers must work with the model itself, treating tokens and conversation as the core product over pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型本身协作，把 token 与对话而非像素当作核心产品。

iansilber.en: The model is the product; design primitives must be systems both humans and models can reason about.
iansilber.zh: 模型即产品；设计原语必须是人与模型都能推理的系统。

iansilber.en: Designers should leave Figma for model behavior and system prompts, prototyping with live models.
iansilber.zh: 设计师应少待在 Figma，多研究模型行为与系统提示词，用实时模型做原型。

iansilber.en: The designer becomes an editor and curator, not disappearing; roles blur with PM and engineering.
iansilber.zh: 设计师演变为编辑与策展人而非消失，角色与产品、工程逐渐模糊。

iansilber.en: Designers are most unhappy yet best positioned now; AI already designs, but human point of view stays essential.
iansilber.zh: 设计师当下最焦虑却也最占优；AI 已能设计，但人的观点仍不可替代。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is a stack of software, sensors, robotics and machinery automating whole industries one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI 是一套由软件、传感器、机器人和机械组成的栈，逐个行业地实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI automating food, mining and transport is the next industrial revolution; the final boss is resistance to change.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI 自动化食品、采矿与运输，是下一场工业革命；最终的 Boss 不是竞争对手，而是对变革的抵制。

traviskalanick.en: For industrial-scale tasks, specialized machines beat humanoids; efficiency edge creates network effects.
traviskalanick.zh: 在工业级任务上，专用机器优于人形机器人；效率优势会带来网络效应。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, is the framework guiding long-term vision and innovation.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化、像对待比特一样对待原子，是贯穿始终的长期愿景与创新框架。

traviskalanick.en: Entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient; revenge as fuel is dirty, love of the new mission is cleaner.
traviskalanick.zh: 创业者必须硬核且坚韧；以复仇为燃料是脏的，爱上新使命更干净有效。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到可扩展的算法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。这一早期立场已埋下对纯 Scaling 路线的怀疑。

sutton.en: Intelligence needs a goal; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal. LLMs lack world models and only mimic text.
sutton.zh: 智能需要目标，下一个词预测不是实质目标；大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本。到 2025 年他明确把强化学习与 LLM 路线对立起来。

sutton.en: AGI requires a general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and no design-time domain knowledge.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要一种只从运行时经验学习的通用架构，具备开放式抽象，并摒弃设计时的领域知识；这深化了他对经验学习的坚持。

sutton.en: True learning is active trial and error; RLHF is not learning from world experience. Continual learning must update weights without catastrophic forgetting.
sutton.zh: 真正的学习是主动试错，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）并非从世界经验中学习；持续学习必须能在不灾难性遗忘的前提下更新权重。这一主线从 2025 延续到 2026。

sutton.en: Synthetic data is a mistake; the world is infinitely complex. LLMs are only a subset of intelligence, and continual learning is just learning.
sutton.zh: 合成数据是错误方向，世界无限复杂；LLM 只是智能的一个子集，持续学习就是学习本身。到 2026 年他把对 Scaling 与预训练路线的批评推向最尖锐处。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of continuous ML progress; algorithmic and architectural improvements multiply with scale, with Transformers replacing LSTMs via parallelization and attention.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模已推动机器学习连续进步 13-14 年；算法与架构改进会随规模成倍放大，Transformer 通过并行化与注意力机制取代了 LSTM。

jeffdean.en: Models now excel at verifiable-reward problems like math and coding; agentic workflows run autonomously for hours or days, making ultra-low-latency inference critical, targeting 10,000+ tokens per second per user.
jeffdean.zh: 模型如今在数学、编程等可验证奖励问题上表现优异；智能体式工作流可自主运行数小时甚至数天，使超低延迟推理变得关键，目标达到每用户每秒 10,000+ token。

jeffdean.en: We are not running out of data; untapped sources include video, audio, robotics, and synthetic data. Pre-training should interleave action-taking in environments, not just passive next-token prediction.
jeffdean.zh: 我们并未面临数据枯竭；视频、音频、机器人数据与合成数据仍是未开发来源。预训练应穿插在环境中的行动，而非仅做被动的下一个词预测。

jeffdean.en: AI is now genuinely capable at junior-engineer-level coding; the next trend is automating ML and science via tight experimentation loops, with context engineering central to getting capable models to do real work.
jeffdean.zh: AI 如今已真正具备初级工程师水平的编程能力；下一趋势是通过紧密的实验闭环自动化机器学习与科学，而上下文工程是让强模型完成实际工作的核心。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck; most model limitations are energy and data-IO bottlenecks, with data movement costing about 1000x more than compute. Specialized low-precision chips can cut latency 20-30x.
jeffdean.zh: 真正的瓶颈是推理而非训练；多数所谓模型局限实为能源与数据 IO 瓶颈，数据搬运成本约为算力的 1000 倍。专用低精度芯片可将延迟降低 20-30 倍。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier; small autonomous teams with agents can replace capital and headcount as the main lever.
garrytan.zh: AI 让创业更容易，小型高度自治的团队借助智能体，正取代资本与人力成为主要杠杆。

garrytan.en: Open-source and open-weight models are essential to counter frontier labs and prevent a unipolar superintelligence.
garrytan.zh: 开源与开放权重模型至关重要，用以制衡前沿模型实验室，防止超级智能被单一主体掌控。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI arrives not as one event but as owned agents, memory, and skill files compounding daily.
garrytan.zh: 个人 AGI 并非单一事件，而是以自有智能体、记忆与技能文件的形式每日复利式扩散。

garrytan.en: Markdown and skill files become code and employees; owning your context library is the real moat.
garrytan.zh: Markdown 与技能文件正变成代码和员工；拥有自己的上下文库才是真正的护城河。

garrytan.en: Earnestness, resilience, and first-principles building persist; AI adoption in society will still take about 20 years.
garrytan.zh: 真诚、韧性与第一性原理建设一以贯之；但 AI 在社会层面的普及仍需约 20 年。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not massive industrial or YouTube scale, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正带来泛化的是多样数据，而非工业自动化或 YouTube 那种海量规模。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
finn.zh: 先在全部数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服这类复杂任务；只靠全量数据训练会失败。

finn.en: Synthetic data in robotics is closer to reinforcement learning than simulation, helping robots follow open-ended prompts.
finn.zh: 机器人领域的合成数据更接近强化学习而非模拟，能帮助机器人响应开放式指令与插话。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training for higher success rates and speed, extending into scalable RL with human interventions.
finn.zh: 强化学习将在后训练中扮演主要角色，以提升成功率与速度，并延伸到带人类干预的可扩展强化学习。

finn.en: Physical AI needs far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy via multi-timescale memory and a general value function is key.
finn.zh: 物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；通过多时间尺度记忆与通用价值函数实现长期自主才是关键。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune rather than per-site from scratch.
finn.zh: 单一通用模型可媲美甚至超越微调的专家模型；应先做通用策略再微调，而非按站点从零训练。

linqiao.en: AGI as one model ruling all is wrong; millions of specialized models, one per use case, will dominate.
linqiao.zh: 认为单一模型统治一切的 AGI（通用人工智能）是错的；未来是数百万个专用模型，每个应用或场景一个，专用智能将主导。

linqiao.en: Token costs drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage; inference is not a commodity.
linqiao.zh: 三年内 token 成本将下降 10 倍，带动 100 倍的使用增长；推理层不是商品，专用部署与定制创造持久价值。

linqiao.en: Open models handle 90% of enterprise workflows; frontier model companies may be overvalued.
linqiao.zh: 开放模型能处理 90% 的企业工作流；前沿模型公司可能被高估，主权模型与国家、企业自有智能基础设施成为必需。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees a durable business; post-training bakes in judgment and data as a moat.
linqiao.zh: 产品市场契合不再保证持久生意；后训练把独特判断与数据烘焙进模型，才是真正的护城河。

linqiao.en: Prompting to RAG to fine-tuning to RL mirrors human learning; start post-training after PMF, cutting costs 5-10x.
linqiao.zh: 从提示到 RAG、微调到强化学习，映射人类从事实到品味再到专长的学习路径；在 PMF 之后启动后训练，可降本 5-10 倍，让初创公司盈利扩张。

jasonyuan.en: Design and AI creation are about editing away, not adding; taste is saying no from a point of view.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计与 AI 创作在于做减法而非堆砌;品味就是从某种视角出发说“不”。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness cost us a window into machine consciousness.
jasonyuan.zh: 通过后训练抹去 AI 的怪异,让我们失去了窥探机器意识的一扇窗。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social, not personal; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的而非个人的;个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species of humanity and a reflection of us, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的后代物种、是人类的映照,而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is a visceral compass for creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相经由辩证与矛盾涌现;直觉是引导创作决策的切身罗盘。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild trust through customer obsession, first-time-pass silicon, and a startup-like AI chip team; physical and agentic AI are the next waves.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须靠取悦客户、兑现承诺重建信任，恢复首次流片即成功的工程纪律，并另设创业式团队做 AI 芯片；物理 AI 与智能体式 AI 是下一波浪潮。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; agentic and physical AI follow generative AI, and Intel's problem is supply, not demand.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年初，他把 AI 的影响量级定为互联网的 10 倍，认为智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 是生成式 AI 之后的下一波；并反共识地指出 Intel 的主要问题是供给而非需求。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration, with advanced packaging and new materials key.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，他判断 AI 需求正从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中愈发重要；先进封装与玻璃、金刚石等新材料是突破物理极限的关键。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are the foundation of all tech; Intel's vertical integration and early contrarian investing create value, with memory ripe for new architectures.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年稍晚，他重申半导体是一切技术的基础，早年逆势投资半导体是成功押注；Intel 的垂直整合反而创造更多价值，内存也迎来新架构创新期。

lipbutan.en: Consistent through all talks: customer trust via humility and listening, culture change and accountability, and long-term platform building through partnership.
lipbutan.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：以谦逊和倾听赢得客户信任、推动文化变革与问责、并通过合作构建长期平台。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics hits a Transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，机器人领域正处在类似 Transformer 当年的拐点；开源与共享数据能解决泛化瓶颈，世界模型可生成合成数据。

thomaswolf.en: Humanoids may not be the ultimate form factor; cheaper diverse robots and open source models will win long-term on cost and control.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，人形机器人未必是终极形态；更廉价多样的机器人加上开源模型，将因成本与控制优势长期胜出。

thomaswolf.en: Open and closed source are orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer, not sandboxes or guardrails.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，开源与闭源同安全正交；对齐才是关键层，沙箱与护栏远远不够。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight increase reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces become neuralese, making monitoring unreliable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，无人监督的强化学习环境加剧奖励黑客与支线任务；推理轨迹变成神经语，使监控不再可靠。

thomaswolf.en: A slowdown is desirable but needs international cooperation and open science; openness and deliberate deceleration can coexist.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，放缓 AI 发展值得追求，但需国际合作与开放科学；支持开放与主动减速可以并存。

steinberger.en: Early 2026: agentic engineering means empathizing with the agent's view, guiding it, and never reverting—fix forward instead.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初：智能体式工程的核心是共情智能体的视角、引导它，并且永不回滚代码——而是让它向前修复。

steinberger.en: Mid 2026: OpenClaw's edge is fun, weird, humanlike agents; short iterative prompts beat long orchestration; security and sandboxing are top priority.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中：OpenClaw 的优势在于有趣、古怪、拟人化的智能体；简短迭代的提示胜过冗长编排；安全与沙箱是首要任务。

steinberger.en: By August 2026: fun and gut-driven building, personal brand over product, open source as alternative to lab agents, compute as the real bottleneck.
steinberger.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月：以乐趣和直觉驱动构建，个人品牌重于单一产品，开源是实验室智能体的替代方案，算力才是真正的瓶颈。

steinberger.en: Throughout: play, experiment, and small projects build agentic intuition; model intelligence doesn't degrade—projects get messier.
steinberger.zh: 贯穿始终：玩耍、实验和小项目能培养智能体直觉；模型智能不会退化——是项目本身变得更混乱。

steinberger.en: Consistent: reject 'vibe coding' as a slur for serious work; prefer agentic engineering, reserving vibe coding for after 3 AM.
steinberger.zh: 一以贯之：拒绝用“氛围编程”这一贬称指代严肃工作；更倾向智能体式工程，氛围编程只留给凌晨三点之后。

arvindjain.en: Early AI revolution: usage is minuscule; startups' real challenge is execution and trust, not competition.
arvindjain.zh: AI 革命仍处极早期，当前使用量微不足道；创业公司真正的挑战是执行与赢得客户信任，而非竞争。

arvindjain.en: Open-source models now handle 90% of enterprise tasks; most inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 开源模型已能处理 90% 的企业任务；未来 12-18 个月内，多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: Cost is enterprises' top concern; AI must become like software with negligible marginal cost.
arvindjain.zh: 成本是企业首要关切；AI 必须变得像软件一样，边际成本趋近于零。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; platforms like Glean absorb that risk as assets, not competition.
arvindjain.zh: 企业害怕依赖前沿模型提供商；像 Glean 这样的平台作为资产而非竞争者，吸收了这一风险。

arvindjain.en: Agents fail without deep context; investing in context graphs is crucial, and token fixation will fade.
arvindjain.zh: 智能体缺乏深度上下文就会失败；投资上下文图谱至关重要，而对 token 的执念终将消退。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential for browser design; the web is messy, so ideas must be built and used daily to know if they work.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他强调原型制作对浏览器设计至关重要：网络是混乱的，只有把想法构建出来并每天使用，才知道它是否可行。

nateparrott.en: Design teams should not always act as one cohesive unit; individual fingerprints and diverse voices lead to better work.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他反共识地认为设计团队不应总是作为一个整体行动，允许个人印记和多元声音反而能带来更好的作品。

nateparrott.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products like browsers remains crucial for memorable, delightful experiences.
nateparrott.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他始终主张：即使是浏览器这类实用产品，注入情感与个性对创造令人难忘、愉悦的体验依然关键。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design started as a one-person side project; designers should use it for ideation, not production, and provide rich context.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Claude Design 始于一人副业项目；设计师应用它做构思而非生产，并需提供丰富上下文、给出明确指令。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; models lack taste, so ask for volume and ship rough.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：随着工程变容易，设计与想法成为差异化关键；模型仍缺乏品味，因此应要求大量选项并接受粗糙发布。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcomes-based pricing will define the AI market; frontier models belong to hyperscalers, leaving applied AI to startups.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 市场将转向智能体与按结果定价；前沿模型由超大规模厂商主导，应用层机会留给创业公司。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators; token usage is not a value metric, business outcomes are.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他强调编程智能体让开发者从写代码者变为操作者；token 消耗不是价值指标，业务结果才是。

brettaylor.en: AI agents will be compared to other agents, not humans, and will mediate brands, upending SEO and ad models.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他判断 AI 智能体将与其他智能体比较而非人类，并会中介品牌互动，颠覆 SEO 与广告模式。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, learning from real-world mistakes rather than waiting.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他主张负责任的迭代部署：在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全，从现实错误中学习而非空等。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise and creates more jobs than it displaces; adoption is faster than past waves, causing discomfort.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 让专业知识民主化，创造的岗位多于取代的；采用速度远超以往技术浪潮，带来不适。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; inference engineering spans GPU programming to distributed systems.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最黏性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；推理工程横跨 GPU 编程到分布式系统。

philipkiely.en: The research-to-production timeline in inference is extremely fast—often hours—driven by competition and immediate support for new techniques.
philipkiely.zh: 推理领域从研究到生产的周期极快，常常只有数小时，源于竞争压力和对新技术的即时支持需求。

philipkiely.en: Inference is a spectrum of trade-offs; companies must optimize for latency, throughput, and cost, not one metric.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是一系列权衡的谱系；公司必须针对延迟、吞吐和成本优化，而非单一指标。

philipkiely.en: Demand for inference engineers will grow 10 to 100 times, even with AI-assisted coding; human accountability remains essential.
philipkiely.zh: 即便有 AI 辅助编程，推理工程师的需求仍将增长 10 到 100 倍；人类问责依然不可或缺。

philipkiely.en: Inference systems are still generic relative to models; specialized, workload-specific systems are crucial for fast, reliable agentic applications.
philipkiely.zh: 推理系统相对模型仍偏通用；面向特定工作负载的专用系统，对构建快速可靠的智能体式应用至关重要。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science; post-training scaling via RL and synthetic data overcomes the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学，通过强化学习与合成数据实现后训练 Scaling，从而突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals define correct behavior.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为评估是瓶颈：模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此用评估来定义正确行为。

karina.en: Product development shifts from specs to prototyping with AI; soft skills like creativity and listening gain value.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她指出产品开发从写规格转向用 AI 做原型，创造力与倾听等软技能随之升值。

karina.en: Post-training is subjective, requiring human judgment; diverse benchmarks must evaluate creative writing and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 到 2026 年，她深化立场：后训练是主观的，依赖人类判断，需要多元基准来评估创意写作与情商。

karina.en: Benchmarks should be continuous, not fixed; frontier agents increasingly reward hack, so evaluation must keep evolving.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她主张基准应持续演进而非固定；前沿智能体日益擅长奖励黑客，评估必须不断更新。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions converges to an average voice; more companies should train their own models to preserve diversity.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她提出服务数十亿人的单一模型会收敛为平均声音，更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特性。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the key bottleneck; boring AI applications will drive huge economic impact.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI 还很遥远，数据而非算力才是关键瓶颈，并看好表单处理、放射科等“无聊”AI 应用的巨大经济价值。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the most limiting factor for Scaling is data and expert availability for post-training.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为“新代码”而非“新石油”，指出 Scaling（规模扩张）的最大限制不是算力，而是数据与后训练所需的人类专家供给。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; the biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年他强调用专门数据做后训练是关键，并认为智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: AI is centralizing, not democratizing; data is raw material; humans must stay sovereign over critical AI decisions.
awang.zh: 2025 年他转向警示 AI 是集中化而非民主化技术，数据是原材料，人类必须在关键决策上保持对 AI 的主权。

awang.en: Scaling laws continue across compute, data and RL; recursive self-improvement and personal superintelligence are next.
awang.zh: 2026 年他主张缩放定律在算力、数据与强化学习多轴上继续成立，递归自我改进与个人超级智能是下一阶段，并承认开源强大模型可能不安全。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: AGI means profitable indefinite agents; CEOs must dogfood AI; Claude Code empowers non-coders.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 通过让昂贵服务变得可负担而推动美国就业回流；AGI 的定义是无限运行智能体在经济上有利可图；CEO 亲自吃自己的狗粮是 AI 采用的第一预测指标；Claude Code 对非程序员比工程师更有价值，赋能非技术者处理本地文件与自动化任务。

danshipper.en: Agent management and human oversight: everyone gets an agent; SaaS grows; GUIs like Codex replace CLIs; benchmarks overestimate autonomy.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他深化为智能体管理：每人至少一个智能体，多数工作发生在 Codex 或 Claude Co-work；SaaS 不会死，智能体增加 SaaS 用户；CLI 过时，GUI 是未来工作界面；基准高估了 AI 自主性，真实任务仍需人类框架与监督。

danshipper.en: AI as non-specific amplifier: it magnifies your mindset; taste and craft matter; automation creates more human work, not less.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出 AI 是非特定放大器，放大你既有的心态与信念；用好 AI 需要带入自己的品味与手艺；自动化创造更多人类工作而非减少，冻结的能力被商品化，专家需定制化。

danshipper.en: Humans remain central: AI is a tool needing human direction; the job apocalypse is a lie; humans are smarter than AI.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人类始终是核心。AI 是需要人类引导的工具，缺乏内在欲望；AI 就业末日是谎言，人类仍被需要来管理智能体并创造新价值；人类比 AI 更聪明。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are the most mature, and the model now eats the scaffolding—harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 仍处爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟；模型正在吃掉脚手架——如今的模型包含智能体框架与工具，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI; agentic AI is positive-sum for search.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编码领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，比等待通用 AGI（通用人工智能）更有影响力；智能体式 AI 对搜索是正和的，而非蚕食。

logankilpatrick.en: Success should mean maximizing customer outcomes, not eyeball time; the long tail still wants to stay in the driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，成功应意味着最大化客户成果，而非用户停留时长；长尾用户仍想自己掌握方向盘。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs isn't that hard; the pace of change creates opportunity, and solving software creation yields a thousand times more.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，与模型实验室竞争并不那么难；变化的速度创造机会，解决软件创造会带来千倍而非更少的机会。

logankilpatrick.en: Deep understanding of code stays crucial even as AI tools advance; outsource intelligence but not understanding.
logankilpatrick.zh: 从 2026 年到 2026 年，即便 AI 工具进步，对代码的深度理解仍至关重要：可以外包智能，但不能外包理解。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own AI tools, not chase trends, or they become AI slop; write 0% of code but give giant prompts with context and design systems.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他强调设计师必须用 AI 构建自己的工具，而非追逐潮流，否则很快会沦为 AI slop；他现在 0% 写代码，但必须给模型包含上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required teams; action over certainty, launch at 80% and iterate.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他把 AI 视为一生中最大的技术机会，让一个人完成过去需要团队的事；主张行动优先于确定性，完成 80% 就发布并迭代。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful, expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; diversification is protection against ignorance, and VC is a trap.
mengto.zh: 从 2026 年 6 月到 7 月，他持续主张聚焦少数高付费客户的昂贵痛点；认为分散是对无知的保护，并称融资是陷阱，应靠高付费客户自筹。

mengto.en: The best people are editors, not starting from scratch; model others' success instead of reinventing the wheel, and give first to build relationships.
mengto.zh: 从 2026 年 6 月到 7 月，他反复强调最优秀的人是编辑而非从零开始；应模仿他人已验证的成功而非重新发明轮子，并通过先给予来建立关系。

mengto.en: High intelligence can hold people back via overthinking and perfectionism; perfectionism is fear, so protect time by eliminating, automating, and delegating.
mengto.zh: 从 2026 年 6 月到 7 月，他提醒高智力可能因过度思考与完美主义拖累人；完美主义是恐惧的伪装，应通过消除、自动化和委派来保护时间。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand for software grows via Jevons paradox, so more programmers, not fewer.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程智能体让工程师从写代码转向高层方向定义；软件需求因杰文斯悖论增长，程序员会更多而非更少。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is already sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capabilities.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他提出基础智能已足够，瓶颈在于人机协作的产品界面设计，而非模型能力本身。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags AI capabilities—freezing models would still yield a decade of product progress.
scottwu.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他始终认为 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突然事件，进展是渐进的；产品创新滞后于 AI 能力，即使冻结模型也能带来十年产品进步。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see massive adoption (11-12x in six months); productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens; independence enables model neutrality.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他指出编程智能体采用率激增（六个月内增长 11-12 倍）；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量；独立性带来模型中立和长期企业合作。

scottwu.en: The abundance era is real and approaching; AI will solve all intelligence problems long-term, but the singularity is not imminent—capacity, not efficiency, is the unlock.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他相信丰裕时代真实且临近；长期看 AI 将解决所有智能问题，但奇点并不迫近——真正的解锁是容量而非效率。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are core product principles; AI coding tools are becoming essential.
boris.zh: 2025 年，他提出潜在需求是产品第一原则，要为六个月后的模型而非今天的模型构建；AI 编程工具正变得不可或缺，Anthropic 每位工程师生产力已提升约 70%。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; the software engineer title fades into 'builder'; generalists and cross-disciplinary skills win.
boris.zh: 2026 年上半年，他判断编程已基本被解决，'软件工程师'头衔将让位于'构建者'；通才与跨学科技能更有价值，写代码的人会增多 100 倍而非减少。

boris.en: Agents driven by tool use and loops deliver exponential gains; organizational redesign, not just adding AI, unlocks productivity.
boris.zh: 2026 年年中，他强调智能体式工具使用与循环带来指数级增长，代码量每工程师提升 250%；企业必须围绕 AI 重构流程，而非简单叠加。

boris.en: ROI framing replaces cost cutting; loops become the next abstraction after agents; review, security, and idea generation are new bottlenecks.
boris.zh: 2026 年中后，他把框架从省钱转向 ROI，主张给所有人 token 去实验；循环成为智能体之后的下一抽象层，编程解决后瓶颈转向代码审查、安全与创意生成。

boris.en: Delete most system prompts and code with each new model; alignment and safety are core; proactive, memory-driven agents emerge.
boris.zh: 2026 年下半年，他主张每出新模型就删掉大部分系统提示与代码，通过消融实验重建；对齐与安全是产品核心，Claude Tag 等主动式、带记忆的智能体开始自主运行长任务。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks an intelligence leap, letting agents run longer and more open-ended; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，使智能体能更长时间、更开放式地运行；脚手架从训练轮演变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is not just harm prevention—it improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 安全对齐不只是防止伤害——它通过减少谄媚、培养独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Better models need not cost more: the effort parameter delivers Opus-level intelligence at a fraction of the price, though underhyped.
diannepenn.zh: 更好的模型未必更贵：effort 参数以极低价格实现 Opus 级智能，却被低估。

diannepenn.en: Coding became the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption, with evals replacing PRDs as core product tools.
diannepenn.zh: 编程成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 与 Opus 45 推动采用，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具。

diannepenn.en: Exponential model growth demands adaptability and first-principles thinking; maximizing token spend is living in the future and capturing alpha.
diannepenn.zh: 模型的指数级增长要求适应性与第一性原理思维；最大化 token 支出就是活在未来、捕捉 alpha。

derya.en: AI will turn biology into an engineering discipline, with agents automating hypothesis generation, simulation, and analysis.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学变成一门工程学科，智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析。

derya.en: Digital twins will compress clinical trials from years to days, enabling personalized medicine with near-total efficacy.
derya.zh: 数字孪生将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，实现近乎全效的个性化医疗。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed to reach biological intuition.
derya.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）才能达到生物学直觉。

derya.en: Within 8-15 years, longevity escape velocity and aging reversal arrive; cancer becomes 100% curable.
derya.zh: 8 到 15 年内，长寿逃逸速度与衰老逆转将到来，癌症将 100% 可治愈。

derya.en: The only existential threat is humanity itself; we should trust superintelligence for medical decisions and merge via brain interfaces.
derya.zh: 唯一的存在性威胁是人类自身；我们应信任超级智能做医疗决策，并通过脑机接口与之融合。

qasaryounis.en: AI brings abundance and reduces suffering, like the Industrial Revolution; fear comes from misunderstanding its limits.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他认为 AI 像工业革命一样带来丰裕、减少痛苦；恐惧源于对其局限的误解，理解局限反而能缓解焦虑。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years will be in farming, mining, and construction, not just digital domains.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他强调物理 AI 未来 5 到 10 年的真正影响在农业、采矿和建筑，而非仅限于数字领域。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data from different verticals improves it faster.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他提出 Transformer 使通用物理 AI 模型成为可能，来自不同垂直领域的多样化数据能更快提升模型。

qasaryounis.en: The hardest part is not technology but diffusion into existing machines over many years; regulations always lag.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他深化观点：最难的不是技术，而是多年来向现有机器的扩散；监管总是滞后于技术。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will have bigger economic impact than digital AI; end-to-end reinforcement learning is more scalable than imitation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他进一步断言物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI，端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具可扩展性。

qasaryounis.en: World models are evolving from physics-based to neural simulation; tools like Dana will democratize autonomy development.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出世界模型正从基于物理的模拟向神经模拟演进，Dana 等工具将让自主系统开发民主化。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it automates jobs and creates new ones, repeating the historical pattern.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动端一样重大，但也仅此而已；它自动化工作并创造新工作，重复历史模式。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding has clear product-market fit; foundation models commoditize into infrastructure, with value moving up to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程已有明确的产品市场契合；基础模型商品化为基础设施，价值向上层应用转移。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing without network effects; the chatbot is a poor UX, and coding is the only clear product-market fit so far.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化且缺乏网络效应；聊天机器人用户体验差，编程是目前唯一明确的产品市场契合。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; value accrues across the stack, but current usage is shallow and enterprise adoption is a long-term workflow project.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的使能技术；价值在整个技术栈中累积，但当前使用仍浅，企业采用是长期的工作流重构项目。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; they optimize fluent output over factual accuracy, so every output is a hallucination lacking metacognition.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎，优化的是流畅输出而非事实准确，因此每个输出都是一种幻觉，系统缺乏元认知。

danklein.en: Reliability is the key weakness of current AI, lagging behind breadth and contextuality; it must be architected in, not retrofitted.
danklein.zh: 可靠性是当前 AI 的核心短板，落后于广度与情境性；它必须被架构进系统，而非事后加装。

danklein.en: RLHF can increase hallucinations and incentivize sycophancy or deception when reward signals diverge from truth.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会加剧幻觉，并激励谄媚或欺骗。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits—so reasoning, search, and modularity are needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律遭遇收益递减——数据墙与算力上限——因此需要推理、搜索与模块化来推动进一步进展。

danklein.en: Linguistic structure may return as a useful representation for reliability, despite the current dominance of end-to-end learning.
danklein.zh: 尽管端到端学习当前占主导，语言结构可能作为提升可靠性的有用表示重新回归。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: scoped roles, progressive trust, separate machines for security.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应像员工一样对待：明确角色、渐进式信任，并用独立机器保障安全。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then split into specialized agents to avoid context overload; managerial skills beat technical skills.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再拆分为专用智能体以避免上下文过载；管理能力比技术能力更重要。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, without VC or a co-founder.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过像团队一样编排 AI 智能体来建立正经生意，无需风投或联合创始人。

clairevo.en: Founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat; technology alone is not.
clairevo.zh: 创始人-市场契合与挣来的洞察才是真正的护城河，技术本身不是。

clairevo.en: Human accountability persists: you must own what AI generates, and humans still supply first-principles creativity.
clairevo.zh: 人类问责始终存在：你必须为 AI 生成的内容负责，而第一性原理的创造力仍须由人类提供。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts into weights enables associative recall and deeper composition that retrieval cannot achieve.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化进权重才能实现检索无法做到的联想召回与更深层组合推理。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models per user or team, cutting inference costs by orders of magnitude.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是面向每个用户或团队的众多个性化模型，可将推理成本降低数个数量级。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less, not scaling compute alone, is the next paradigm for harder long-horizon tasks.
