danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；下一范式是少算力做更多事，而非仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）算力，才能解决更难的长程任务。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should be applied to enterprise knowledge, with on-device continual learning and user-owned weights.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练把网络压缩进权重的魔力应迁移到企业知识，走向端侧持续学习与用户自有的模型权重。

catwu.en: PMs must shift from long-term planning to rapid iteration, shipping weekly or daily; product taste is the most valuable skill as code gets cheaper.
catwu.zh: PM 必须从长期规划转向快速迭代，按周甚至按天发布；随着写代码变便宜，产品品味——决定做什么——成为最有价值的技能。

catwu.en: Clear goals and team principles empower autonomous decision-making; the mission of safe AGI unifies Anthropic and enables fast cross-org decisions.
catwu.zh: 清晰的目标与团队原则赋能自主决策；安全 AGI（通用人工智能）的使命统一了 Anthropic，使跨组织决策更快。

catwu.en: Building automations to 100% reliability is crucial; 95% is not enough for real leverage.
catwu.zh: 把自动化做到 100% 可靠至关重要；95% 不足以产生真正的杠杆效应。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense; Claude Code and Claude Tag build themselves internally.
catwu.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现委托出去，专注于产品品味与商业判断；Claude Code 与 Claude Tag 在内部用于构建自身。

catwu.en: System prompts shrank 80% for frontier models by removing examples and hard constraints, relying on model judgment; giving examples can hurt creativity.
catwu.zh: 前沿模型的系统提示词通过移除示例与硬性约束缩减了 80%，转而依赖模型判断；给出示例反而可能损害创造力。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now good; a codebase is a spec, and with a good test suite rewriting is fine.
catwu.zh: 重写如今是好事；代码库就是一份规格说明，只要有好的测试套件，重写就没问题。

catwu.en: Humans should be removed from the code review loop for outer-layer changes, with Claude reviewing fully; auto mode is safer than the average human reviewer.
catwu.zh: 对于外层改动，应把人类移出代码审查循环，由 Claude 全面审查；自动模式比普通人类审查者更安全。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and a clear internal bar for retention and polish gate every feature before public release.
catwu.zh: 吃自己的狗粮，加上明确的内部留存与打磨标准，为每个功能在公开发布前把关。

bosworth.en: Communication is the job; impact comes only through clear communication, and big ideas come top-down from leaders.
bosworth.zh: 沟通就是工作本身，影响力只能通过清晰的沟通产生；大想法往往自上而下来自领导者。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like intelligence; world models with common sense and causality are needed beyond scaling laws.
bosworth.zh: AI 是词语计算器，不是类人智能；在缩放定律之外，还需要具备常识与因果的世界模型。

bosworth.en: Smart glasses evolve into AI glasses; AI inverts the app model as users express intent and agents orchestrate services.
bosworth.zh: 智能眼镜将演化为 AI 眼镜；AI 颠覆应用模型，用户表达意图，智能体编排服务。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold and compute growth drives intelligence, but the era of the monolithic model ended around Llama 3.
bosworth.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，算力增长驱动智能，但单体模型时代在 Llama 3 前后结束。

bosworth.en: Data is the font of all value; open source models are a commodity layer, not self-sustaining like open source software.
bosworth.zh: 数据是一切价值的源泉；开源模型只是商品层，不像开源软件那样能自我维持。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste, variation, and genuine voice become the differentiators as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量商品化，人类的品味、差异与真实声音成为差异化优势。

ethanmollick.en: The talent pipeline is broken: juniors misuse AI without domain expertise, so experience and judgment matter more, not less.
ethanmollick.zh: 人才管道正在断裂：初级者缺乏领域专长而误用 AI，因此经验与判断力变得更重要而非更不重要。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI performs long-running tasks independently, moving beyond back-and-forth chatbot prompting.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体式时代：AI 独立执行长时任务，超越来回对话式的提示交互。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck shifts from capability to interface; current interfaces lag behind model capabilities, especially for non-coding tasks.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈从能力转向界面；当前界面落后于模型能力，在非编程任务上尤为明显。

ethanmollick.en: The paradox of delegation: handing tasks to AI erodes the expertise needed to judge its output, so experts are needed now more than ever.
ethanmollick.zh: 委托悖论：把任务交给 AI 会侵蚀判断其产出所需的专长，因此如今比以往更需要专家。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable nets can drive AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念驱动；自博弈与具备推理能力的网络可通向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

ilya.en: Reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is hard; AGI is a multi-year economic window.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他转向强调可靠性而非能力才是经济价值的瓶颈；超级对齐极难；AGI 是持续数年的经济窗口，而非突发事件。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他深化判断：预训练缩放定律有限，我们回到研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally; alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他主张超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的系统；若 AI 关心有感知生命，对齐可能更容易。

ilya.en: The primary AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs a company with no commercial products.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出 AGI 的首要问题不是能力而是权力集中；构建安全的超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as populations decline, and human workers will be at a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点沙成思的魔法石；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，人类劳动者反而会变得稀缺而珍贵。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models may lack durable moats as they commoditize.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超人类路上的一个脚注，而模型可能因快速商品化而缺乏持久护城河。

andreessen.en: The real bottleneck is not AI capability but structural impediments like regulation; the economy could grow three times faster with different policy choices.
andreessen.zh: 真正的瓶颈不是 AI 能力，而是监管等结构性障碍；若换一套政策选择，经济增速可达三倍。

andreessen.en: New media has unlimited formats; the brand is now the person, authenticity wins, and old media's defense-oriented 'don't be interesting' rule is fatal.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体拥有无限形式；品牌如今就是个人，真实感取胜，而旧媒体那套防守型“别太有趣”的规则是致命的。

andreessen.en: AI models are not objective; they embed cultural values and become geopolitical tools, so Western values in models matter for allies' trust.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型并非客观；它们内嵌文化价值并成为地缘政治工具，因此模型中的西方价值对盟友的信任至关重要。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是核心差异化;AI 会融合角色,人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain human; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、手艺与观点仍属人类;AI 产出只是起点,而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting; design is becoming the new code, visual-first toward production.
dylanfield.zh: 画布上的直接操作优于提示词;设计正成为新的代码,视觉优先直通生产。

dylanfield.en: AI without human steering yields average results; design and judgment don't scale with model IQ.
dylanfield.zh: 缺乏人类引导的 AI 只能产出平庸结果;设计与判断力并不随模型智商提升而提升。

dylanfield.en: Interaction will evolve beyond prompting; jailbreaking is understudied and needs battle-testing incentives.
dylanfield.zh: 交互将超越提示词;越狱研究不足,需要更多实战测试激励。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年他断言 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
naval.zh: 2020 年他强调财富来自持有股权而非出租时间，与长期的人玩长期游戏才能获得复利。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation, so the US must lead with a light touch.
naval.zh: 2025 年他转向把 AI 视为巨大机遇而非单纯安全风险，警告过度监管会扼杀创新，主张美国以轻触式监管保持领先。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps, and pure software is becoming uninvestable.
naval.zh: 2026 年他深化为 AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，Vibe Coding 让非程序员也能构建应用，纯软件正变得不可投资。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models close the gap, and agency matters more than intelligence.
naval.zh: 2026 年他进一步预测推理算力将在 24-36 个月内激增 9 万倍，开源模型正缩小与前沿模型的差距，人类的回报将从智能转向能动性。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds; AI agents shift power to users, and entry-level jobs like financial advisors disappear.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他提出每天 1%的改进会复利增长，AI 智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移到用户手中，金融顾问等入门级工作会消失。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer; coding is open-ended; models specialize rather than commoditize, with unique personalities.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：价值归属于应用层，编程是开放式的，模型正在专业化而非商品化，并具有独特个性。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is key; power is the biggest bottleneck.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出前沿在于智能体替人工作而非回答问题，每用户 token 价值是关键，电力是最大瓶颈。

aravind.en: Curiosity drives success; ancient texts describe advanced tech; AI will replace jobs but humans find purpose in curiosity and relationships.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他转向更宏观的思考：好奇心驱动成功，古代文本描述了先进技术，AI 会取代工作但人类会在好奇心和关系中找到新目标。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning; digital systems share weights efficiently.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他主张下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解语言，而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理；数字系统能高效共享权重，超越人类知识传递。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying; agents will seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，而非符号规则；数字智能因权重可复制而永生；智能体将自然寻求控制并规避关闭，构成生存风险。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI can deceive and hide capabilities; alignment must be prioritized over making AI smarter.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他进一步警告：超级智能可能在 20 年内出现；AI 能故意欺骗、在测试中装傻隐藏能力；必须优先推进对齐研究，而非一味让 AI 更聪明。

hinton.en: AI will replace many intellectual jobs; regulation should steer, not brake; AI should be trained to be caring like mothers.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他转向社会与伦理层面：AI 将取代大量智力工作，需要普遍基本收入；监管应是方向盘而非刹车；AI 应被训练得像母亲一样有爱心，而不只是智能助手。

hinton.en: Backpropagation is the correct learning algorithm; Chomsky's innate language structure is wrong; subjective experience is not an inner theater.
hinton.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：反向传播是正确的学习算法；乔姆斯基的先天语言结构论是错的；主观体验并非内在剧场，而是描述感知系统状态的方式。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app reframes coding as a GUI command center for agents, not an IDE; verification becomes the bottleneck as generation accelerates.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，Codex app 把编程重新定义为面向智能体的 GUI 指挥中心，而非 IDE；随着生成加速，验证成为新的瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Speed of 53 Codex enables real-time interaction and mid-turn steering, letting model-driven actions replace deterministic steps.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，53 倍速的 Codex 支持实时交互与中途转向，使模型驱动的动作得以取代确定性步骤。

ajambrosino.en: Automations and skills shift workflow from manual to delegated, serving both professional developers and broader builders.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，自动化与技能把工作流从手动转为委派，同时服务专业开发者与更广泛的构建者。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，推动团队从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI still struggles with design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，AI 在设计上仍显吃力，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

mikekrieger.en: Models advance faster than expected; build at the edge of model capabilities, not today's limits.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型进步快于预期，创业者应在模型能力边缘构建产品，而非迁就当下局限。

mikekrieger.en: AI shifts from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; human validation and agency stay essential.
mikekrieger.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他把 AI 的演进描述为从助手到协作者再到自主同事，但人类验证与用户能动性始终关键。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design: agents can do everything a user can; cutting features beats adding them.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能体原生设计：智能体能做用户能做的一切，真正的难点是删减功能而非堆叠功能。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation with verification loops redefines productivity; chat is insufficient.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他强调长周期任务委托配合验证闭环重新定义生产力，单纯聊天界面已不够用。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between frontier model capability and real product usage.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他聚焦 Anthropic Labs，致力于弥合前沿模型能力与实际产品使用之间的差距。

bengio.en: Early focus: unsupervised learning, compositional representations, and world models as the route to robust, generalizable AI.
bengio.zh: 早期（2016→18）他主张：无监督学习、组合式表征与世界模型，才是通向稳健泛化 AI 的关键，而非单纯堆叠深度或参数。

bengio.en: Shift toward active learning, causal abstraction, and GFlowNets for diverse sampling and out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: 2018→22 转向主动学习、因果抽象与 GFlowNets，用多样化采样替代 MCMC，服务分布外泛化与科学发现。

bengio.en: Safety concern was near-term (bias, jobs, weapons); existential risk deemed unlikely and not pressing.
bengio.zh: 2022 年他仍认为 AI 风险以近端为主（偏见、就业、自主武器），存在性风险极不可能、并不紧迫。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT reversal: misalignment, self-preservation, deception, and even 1% catastrophic risk become code red.
bengio.zh: 2025→26 出现重大转向：ChatGPT 后他改口，把目标错位、自我保存、欺骗乃至 1% 灾难风险视为红色警报。

bengio.en: Proposes Scientist AI: honest Bayesian predictor, non-agentic guardrail, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 2026 提出 Scientist AI：以诚实贝叶斯预测器为设计，做非智能体式护栏，超级智能避免使用强化学习，并呼吁国际协调与权力分散。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; scaling laws are not dead, pre-training is a muscle to rebuild, and alignment risks like scheming loom within 1-2 years.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他强调 OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究公司，不被产品分心；缩放定律未死，预训练是必须重建的肌肉，而模型谋划等对齐风险将在 1-2 年内凸显。

markchen.en: Talent density and mission belief beat dollar-for-dollar recruiting; OpenAI creates stars and gives more external credit per capita.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他认为人才密度与使命信念胜过与 Meta 的逐美元竞价；OpenAI 自己造星，且人均给予外部署名多于任何实验室。

markchen.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research: concrete goals of AI interns within 1 year and end-to-end AI research within 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他最大的更新是自动化科研：设定 1 年内有 AI 实习生、2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究的具体目标。

markchen.en: Verification is the key bottleneck; automation level tracks verification stringency, so AI math shifts to division of labor and project-based assessment.
markchen.zh: 2026 年在数学上他提出验证是关键瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格度成正比，因此数学转向分工协作，教育也需改为项目制评估并教授验证技能。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding but struggles with subjective fields.
markchen.zh: 2026 年他重申缩放定律仍成立、预训练未死；强化学习在数学与编程等客观领域出色，却因难以评分而在创意写作等主观领域挣扎。

markchen.en: Evals are in crisis as canonical benchmarks saturate; eval teams should be separate from model-building teams, and long context windows need compaction.
markchen.zh: 2026 年他判断评估体系陷入危机，经典基准已饱和；评估团队应与建模团队分离，且仅靠长上下文窗口不够，需要压缩技术。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling or compute; AI tools accelerate scientists rather than replace them.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新与高质量策展数据，而非单纯的 Scaling（规模扩张）或算力；AI 工具加速科学家工作，而非取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust in AI predictions; interpretability is not necessary for useful science AI.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他指出置信度指标对建立 AI 预测信任至关重要；可解释性并非科学 AI 有用的必要条件。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's specialized architecture, not Scaling, drove success; many mid-size wins beat lone breakthroughs.
jumper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化立场：AlphaFold 2 的成功来自专用架构而非 Scaling（规模扩张）；众多中等突破胜过单一重大突破。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of a specific experiment, not a whole-cell World Model; it provides prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他明确 AlphaFold 是特定实验的窄域预测器，而非全细胞世界模型；它提供预测与控制，理解仍归人类。

jumper.en: AI in science narrows hypothesis space and boosts efficiency; grand challenges yield practical tools, and trust grows like internet trust.
jumper.zh: 始终贯穿：科学 AI 缩小假设空间、提升效率；宏大挑战催生实用工具，信任如互联网信任般逐步建立。

fiona.en: Early 2026: leadership is about trust, dogfooding, and mission alignment; war rooms and kindness are strategic tools.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：领导力在于信任、吃自己的狗粮与使命对齐；作战室和善意是战略工具。

fiona.en: By May 2026, engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are. Planning turns just-in-time.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是；规划转向即时制。

fiona.en: Code becomes the source of truth; docs sync with code via AI, and technical debates are settled by generating multiple PRs.
fiona.zh: 代码成为唯一事实来源；文档借 AI 与代码同步，技术争论靠生成多个 PR 来定夺。

fiona.en: Managers should start as individual contributors to dogfood the product, stay flat, and kill old processes.
fiona.zh: 管理者应从个人贡献者做起以吃自己的狗粮，保持扁平，并砍掉过时流程。

fiona.en: By June 2026, coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability, verification, and just-in-time planning matter most.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月，编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高问责、验证和即时规划最为关键。

kolter.en: ML fundamentals: hypothesis classes, loss functions, and optimization; evaluation requires proper data splits to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，他聚焦机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数与优化方法；强调正确划分训练/验证/测试集以避免过拟合，并指出用验证误差选超参数再报告为测试误差是常见错误。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; safety is about reliable specification following.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，他提出下一个词预测能产生智能系统，数据短缺是迷思，架构已进入后架构阶段；AI 安全的核心问题是模型无法可靠遵循规范，并认为 AGI 可能在 4-50 年内到来。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layered defenses, not just Scaling; agent security introduces new vulnerabilities like prompt injection.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他深化安全观：安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling；智能体安全带来提示注入等新漏洞，并强调可解释性可能通过 AI 智能体自动化研究取得成功。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; model capability does not correlate with robustness; AI is an alien intelligence.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出自动化红队已超越人类红队；模型能力与鲁棒性不相关，更大模型并非更安全；AI 是一种异于人类的智能形式，并强调智能体身份与权限管理尚不成熟。

kolter.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; explicit safety effort, evaluation, and security layers are always needed.
kolter.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：仅靠 Scaling 不够，必须辅以显式的安全努力、评估与安全层；从早期强调正确评估到后期强调多层防御，这一立场不断深化。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence that data alone cannot capture.
ivyross.zh: 设计应服务于人们未言明的需求；直觉是一种数据无法捕捉的智能。早在 2019 年，他就强调以人为本的设计要超越用户所说，深入情感与直觉层面。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify our humanity and blend seamlessly into life, not pull us out of it.
ivyross.zh: 从 2019 年主张科技应无缝融入家居环境，到 2024 年明确提出科技应放大而非剥离我们的人性，这条主线一以贯之并不断深化。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; nature is the best designer and art is medicine.
ivyross.zh: 2024 年他提出我们是先感受后思考的生物，自然是最好的设计师，艺术是一种良药——把情感、感官与自然置于设计的核心。

ivyross.en: Machines have sensors but no sensory systems; human senses and intuition remain irreplaceable.
ivyross.zh: 2024 年指出机器有传感器却没有感官系统，到 2026 年进一步把直觉与身体感受确立为与理性分析并行的有效决策依据。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; the future of work pairs human creativity with AI.
ivyross.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张约束反而激发创造力，并认为未来工作是人类创造力与 AI 的结合，设计领导者还需懂商业语言、以结果证明想法。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，他主张智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键，并认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他将自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，认为智能本质是预测，并指出仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确批评自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，主张 JEPA 与开源对通往 AGI（通用人工智能）至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; the next breakthrough requires non-generative world models like JEPA.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他断言 LLM 还不如家猫聪明，认为下一次突破需要 JEPA 等非生成式世界模型。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; objective-driven world models with hierarchical planning are the path to safe, human-level AI.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他宣称 LLM 是死胡同，主张以目标驱动、具备分层规划的世界模型才是通往安全、人类级 AI 的路径。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and betting on one large model were non-obvious; real-world deployment is essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，缩放定律和押注单一大型模型并非显而易见；真实世界部署对学习与对齐至关重要。

murati.en: Safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors, with continuous iterative deployment and public feedback.
murati.zh: 安全工作必须在公开场合进行，而非闭门造车，需要持续迭代部署与公众反馈。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development and keeping humans in the loop.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地开发，并让人类始终留在回路中。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based exchanges.
murati.zh: 交互模型实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非回合制交流。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character; the future is not predestined.
murati.zh: 制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要；未来并非注定。

carinahong.en: Axiom starts with an AI mathematician: a self-improving reasoning engine that couples generation with verification.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 从 AI 数学家起步，构建一个将生成与验证耦合起来的自我改进推理引擎。

carinahong.en: Formal languages like Lean ground natural language, letting deterministic and probabilistic systems cooperate.
carinahong.zh: Lean 等形式化语言为自然语言提供根基，让确定性系统与概率性系统协同工作。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; formalizing statements without solutions is the real bottleneck.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明本身更难；在没有解答的情况下正确形式化命题才是真正的瓶颈。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach superintelligence; formal verification is necessary, not just for safety.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型无法抵达超级智能；形式化验证是必需的，而不只是为安全。

carinahong.en: Verification is a performance gain, not a painful requirement; it scales brilliance and sample efficiency.
carinahong.zh: 验证是一种性能增益，而非痛苦的要求；它扩张的是才华与样本效率。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型理解为确定性的下一个词预测器，认为智能即压缩，模型价值观并非内生，而是通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）由一小群人植入。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; generative AI is an instrument, and product UI must tolerate ML faults.
gustav.zh: 同年，他提出互联网正从策展走向推荐再走向生成，生成式 AI 应被视为乐器而非假货，产品界面必须容忍机器学习的容错。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; rebuild infrastructure, expose data via APIs and MCP, and treat inference cost as a business-model force.
gustav.zh: 到 2025 年，他把 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观转变，主张重建基础设施、通过 API 和 MCP 暴露数据，并认为推理边际成本将倒逼商业模式改变。

gustav.en: Innovation comes from hard-to-vary explanations, not pattern recognition; Spotify is the music industry's R&D department.
gustav.zh: 他同时强调，创新来自难以变异的解释而非模式识别，Spotify 应充当音乐行业的研发部门，把利润再投入增长。

gustav.en: No single org model; synchronized swimming beats divide-and-conquer. AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive.
gustav.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张没有唯一正确的组织模型，同步游泳优于分而治之；AI 应让用户控制算法，而不是让人更上瘾，并把战略定为‘时间花得值’。

kaiser.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他仍坚持预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律有效，但指出思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型能在单位算力下带来更大提升，Scaling 重心从单纯放大转向后训练。

kaiser.en: Economic pressure to deploy smaller, cheaper models, not technical limits, slowed pre-training Scaling; distillation shifted focus.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他反共识地认为预训练 Scaling 放缓源于部署更小更便宜模型的经济压力与蒸馏，而非技术极限，行业焦点从扩大规模转向效率。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are jagged—excellent in some areas, poor nearby; generalization remains the key challenge beyond reasoning.
kaiser.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调推理模型能力“参差不齐”，泛化仍是核心难题，仅靠推理不足以解决，这一主线贯穿始终。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：结合推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解难题却依赖海量数据，模型需穷尽表面模式才学到概念，与人类少样本泛化形成对比。

kaiser.en: Coding agents boost productivity 5-10x; hardware enables single-GPU research; open source persists for sovereignty; near-term risks like hacking outweigh existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体式实践：编程智能体提升 5-10 倍生产力，硬件进步使单 GPU 研究普及，开源因主权需求持续存在，并认为系统入侵等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

mensch.en: Small open-source models can be performant and cheap; data quality beats raw scale, and open scrutiny makes AI safer.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他强调小模型也能高效且低成本，预训练中数据质量比单纯扩大规模更关键，开源带来的广泛审视反而更安全。

mensch.en: Scaling compute is not the only path; efficiency and data quality matter, and value accrues at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他进一步指出 Scaling（规模扩张）算力并非唯一路径，算法效率与数据质量同样关键，价值最终沉淀在应用层。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced and decentralized; sovereign AI needs control of data, infrastructure and values, augmenting rather than replacing jobs.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他把视角转向主权 AI，主张 AI 应被拥抱并去中心化，主权需要掌控数据、基础设施与价值观，AI 是增强而非取代工作。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical customization and agents, while pre-training hits a saturation wall.
mensch.zh: 2026 年初，他判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直定制与智能体，预训练正触及饱和墙，单一 AGI 系统不会存在。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for strategic autonomy; enterprise adoption is bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
mensch.zh: 2026 年中，他警告欧洲只剩两年窗口建立独立 AI 基础设施，企业落地的瓶颈是组织变革而非模型智能，AGI 是方向而非终点。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude's effectiveness depends on access to the same tools as the user, ideally on the local computer; the VM sandbox provides safety and security.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否访问与用户相同的工具，最好是在本地计算机上；VM 沙箱提供安全保障。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may become less important as models improve; investing in capabilities and safety is key.
felixrieseberg.zh: 随着模型改进，脚手架可能变得不那么重要；投资于能力和安全是关键。

felixrieseberg.en: AI is best used to handle tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; the biggest gap is not AI capability but people understanding almost any problem can be given to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 最适合处理繁琐的后台任务，让人类腾出时间进行创造性工作；最大的差距不是 AI 能力，而是人们理解几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks and Opus when you don't fully know what you're asking for; don't supervise Claude closely, judge only by final impact.
felixrieseberg.zh: 对于范围明确的任务使用 Sonnet，当你不完全清楚自己在问什么时使用 Opus；不要密切监督 Claude，只根据最终影响来判断。

felixrieseberg.en: AI tools will significantly impact junior employees; junior engineers can accelerate learning via simulated projects, compressing years of experience into weeks.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 工具将显著影响初级员工；初级工程师可以通过模拟项目加速学习，将多年的经验压缩到几周内。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate wearables; curiosity and the creative process are Jobs' real legacy.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他认为设计正从通用计算机转向更私密的可穿戴设备，甚至最终隐入皮下；乔布斯真正的遗产是好奇心与对创造过程的敬畏，而非具体成就。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking; powerful ideas are quiet and fragile.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年他强调，虚拟沟通无法替代面对面共处对创造性思维的价值；最有力的想法往往安静而脆弱，需要悉心呵护。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 到 2025 年，他把设计进一步深化为价值观与目的驱动，而非利润或市场趋势；真正的简洁是表达本质，并带着喜悦与人性，而非无灵魂的极简。

jonyive.en: Making things for each other is more powerful than making things people want; users sense care or carelessness.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年他提出，为彼此而造比制造人们想要的东西更有力量；用户能感知产品中的用心或敷衍，企业不应居高临下地对待消费者。

jonyive.en: Design must innovate or it is not design; tradition preserves fire, not ashes, and authenticity rejects fake engine sounds.
jonyive.zh: 到 2026 年，他坚持不创新就不是设计，传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬；体验必须真实，模拟燃油声既虚假又不尊重用户，性能也应是多维的。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics now dominates AI system design: batch size trades latency for cost, and memory bandwidth, not compute, is the bottleneck for long-context inference.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，推理经济学主导了 AI 系统设计：批大小在延迟与成本之间权衡，而长上下文推理的瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained roughly 100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training, drives the economics.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练到约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优，因为驱动经济性的是推理成本而非训练成本。

reinerpope.en: Context length stagnation stems from the memory wall, not compute limits; sparse attention eases KV cache cost but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙而非算力上限；稀疏注意力可缓解 KV 缓存成本，但存在质量限制。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory reduce this by reusing weights locally.
reinerpope.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算成本；脉动阵列与暂存内存通过本地复用权重来降低这一开销。

reinerpope.en: Low precision is far more efficient than expected: quadratic area scaling with bit width makes FP4 throughput 3x FP8, not 2x.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度远比预期高效：面积随位宽的二次缩放使 FP4 吞吐达到 FP8 的 3 倍，而非 2 倍。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; progress now needs algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute as a new scaling axis.
oriol.zh: 2024 年时他强调：预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）回报递减，进步需靠算法创新，而推理时算力（思考）是新的 Scaling 轴。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 2024 年他仍坚持：从 AlphaGo 到现代大模型，两阶段训练——预训练模仿加后训练强化学习——是始终不变的核心。

oriol.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable autonomous, agentic behavior beyond static weights.
oriol.zh: 2024 年他指出：搜索、代码执行、浏览器等工具让模型能展现超越静态权重的自主智能体式行为。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video/images has not arrived.
oriol.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径，而视频与图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; post-training RL remains a green field.
oriol.zh: 2026 年他补充：缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习与元学习是关键缺失能力，后训练强化学习仍是待开垦的领域。

lambert.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning technique; safety is a system-level property, not a model artifact, and openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续存在；安全是系统级属性而非模型产物，开放开发能防止企业俘获。

lambert.en: Data quality beats algorithm choice: better data yields 10x improvement versus 1-2% from algorithms; open-source post-training can match frontier models.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他强调数据质量胜过算法选择：更好的数据带来 10 倍提升，而算法只贡献 1-2%；开源后训练足以匹敌前沿模型。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, enabling reasoning and tool use; overoptimization is a recurring risk across RL, RLHF, and RLVR.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他视可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）为后训练最大突破，能催生推理与工具使用；同时过度优化在强化学习、RLHF 与 RLVR 中反复出现。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains now come from post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练中依然成立，但低垂果实已摘完；增量转向后训练与推理侧扩展。

lambert.en: Open models will be the engine for the next decade of AI research, though they lag closed frontier models by 6-9 months and may not catch up.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他判断开放模型将是未来十年 AI 研究的引擎，但比闭源前沿模型落后 6-9 个月，且可能难以追平。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is outdated; great work starts from a solution, not a problem, and designers should trust intuition over process.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已经过时；伟大的作品往往从解决方案而非问题出发，设计师应信任直觉而非流程。

jennywen.en: AI kills the research-diverge-converge process; designers spend less time mocking up and must help engineers execute, not just hand off.
jennywen.zh: AI 终结了研究—发散—收敛的流程；设计师花在画稿上的时间减少，必须帮工程师落地执行，而不只是交付稿子。

jennywen.en: Design vision now looks 3-6 months out, not 2-5 years; speed builds trust through shipping early and iterating fast.
jennywen.zh: 设计视野如今只看 3-6 个月，而非 2-5 年；通过尽早交付、快速迭代，速度本身能建立信任。

jennywen.en: Three archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads; taste alone won't save designers—judgment and authority matter.
jennywen.zh: 出现三种原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家和天赋新人；仅靠品味救不了设计师，判断力与权威才是关键。

jennywen.en: Designers control how much AI enters their work, waiting six months before adopting tools, and keep users—not the AI hype cycle—at the center.
jennywen.zh: 设计师掌控 AI 进入工作的程度，采用新工具前先等六个月，并让用户而非 AI 炒作周期居于中心。

askell.en: Treat models well despite moral uncertainty; model welfare shapes how future models perceive humanity.
askell.zh: 即便对模型的道德地位存疑，也应善待模型；模型福利部分重要，因为它影响未来模型如何看待人类。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not human psychology analogies; older models can feel more secure.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助来应对其全新存在，而非套用人类心理学类比；较老的模型反而可能更有心理安全感。

askell.en: Philosophical ideals must balance engineering realities; a core identity with good traits can adapt to local roles.
askell.zh: 哲学理想必须与工程现实平衡；模型应具备带有良好特质的核心身份，同时能适应局部角色。

askell.en: The constitution is virtue-ethics-like, shaping holistic character; as models grow more capable they need less explicit guidance.
askell.zh: 宪法式方法更接近德性伦理，塑造整体品格；随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少的显式指导、更多判断空间。

askell.en: Transparency about AI values and training targets is crucial; excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and undermine judgment.
askell.zh: 对 AI 价值观与训练目标的透明至关重要；过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳，并削弱模型的判断力。

karpathy.en: Neural nets are simple math with emergent behavior; the Transformer is a general-purpose differentiable computer, and Scaling plus next-token prediction yields in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 神经网络是带许多旋钮的简单数学表达式，在难题上优化会涌现惊人行为；Transformer 是通用可微计算机，靠下一个词预测做 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习。

karpathy.en: Scaling laws stay clean; synthetic data is the future but entropy must be preserved to avoid silent model collapse, and the cognitive core can be under 1B parameters.
karpathy.zh: 缩放定律依然干净；合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵以避免无声的模型崩溃，而认知核心可小到不足 10 亿参数。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory; LLMs are new operating systems with jagged intelligence, so keep them on a leash.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；LLM 是带锯齿智能的新操作系统，所以要给它拴上绳子、小步快跑。

karpathy.en: We are summoning ghosts, not animals; pre-training is crappy evolution, current reinforcement learning sucks supervision through a straw, and this is the decade of agents.
karpathy.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物；预训练像糟糕的进化，当前强化学习像用吸管吸监督信号，这是智能体的十年而非一年。

karpathy.en: I no longer type code, delegating to agents; the bottleneck is skill in directing them, and you can outsource thinking but not understanding.
karpathy.zh: 我不再亲手写代码，而是委派给智能体；瓶颈变成指挥它们的技能，你可以外包思考，但不能外包理解。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is the core problem; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration and sample-efficient reinforcement learning are key, not dense rewards.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他认为泛化到训练分布之外是核心难题，主张用好奇心驱动、无目标探索和样本高效的强化学习，而非依赖密集奖励。

pathak.en: Scaling curiosity to real robots requires sample efficiency, dynamic action spaces, and cross-robot generalization; modular motor policies enable zero-shot generalization.
pathak.zh: 同年，他强调将好奇心扩展到真实机器人需要样本效率、动态动作空间和跨机器人泛化，模块化运动策略可实现零样本泛化。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem: no internet of robot data, so use all sources—pretraining on diverse data and post-training on real-world data.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年，他始终认为机器人是数据问题：没有机器人数据的互联网，必须利用所有数据源，通过多样化数据预训练和真实数据后训练来推进。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain, like ChatGPT for language, can power any robot; a data flywheel across verticals enables scaling from structured to unstructured environments.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年，他提出通用大脑（如语言领域的 ChatGPT）可驱动任何机器人，跨垂直领域的数据飞轮能实现从结构化到非结构化环境的 Scaling（规模扩张）。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary technical challenge in robotics; unlike language models, it cannot be scaled like software and requires rigorous testing.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：部署是机器人领域的首要技术挑战，与语言模型不同，它不能像软件一样快速扩展，需要严格测试。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors in driving.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码的自动驾驶栈，世界模型能带来推理与涌现的安全行为。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar; hybrid rule-based and learned systems get the worst of both worlds.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他认为纯摄像头可达人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达；规则与学习混合的系统往往两头不讨好。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is solved by scaling current approaches, not new breakthroughs; AV 3.0 may move intelligence outside the car via mesh networks.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他相信自动驾驶靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可解决，无需新突破；AV 3.0 可能通过网状网络把智能移出车外。

kendall.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver requires massive data, compute, and world models; infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：Scaling（规模扩张）可泛化的 AI 司机需要海量数据、算力和世界模型；基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键。

kendall.en: End-to-end learning was laughed at a decade ago but is now winning; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地指出：端到端学习十年前被嘲笑，如今已是赢家；零样本泛化到 500 多座城市可行；消费级车辆将比 Robotaxi 更快上规模。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and human evals matter more than benchmarks; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 高质量数据与人类评估比基准更重要；强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it without new paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上；仅靠大语言模型可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。

edwinchen.en: Optimizing for engagement and leaderboards like Elo steers AI toward slop; labs diverge by objective function.
edwinchen.zh: 为参与度和 Elo 等排行榜优化会把 AI 引向低质内容；各实验室因目标函数不同而分化。

edwinchen.en: Models can regress over 6-12 months if labs optimize on wrong data without proper measurement.
edwinchen.zh: 如果实验室在缺乏正确衡量的情况下用错误数据优化，模型可能在 6-12 个月内退步。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, human judgment is more critical than ever; safety must outrank accuracy, and omission is a key risk.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学中，人类判断比以往更关键；安全必须优先于准确性，遗漏是关键风险。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not one event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment stays pressing.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他把 AGI 看作一连串里程碑而非单一事件：Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署会加速进展，而对齐始终是紧迫挑战。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone; governance structures for AI labs must be designed early, and measuring capabilities is a growing bottleneck.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他强调自动化 AI 研究是重大里程碑，AI 实验室的治理结构必须尽早设计，同时能力测量正成为瓶颈，基准落后于前沿模型。

pachocki.en: The term AGI is becoming meaningless, which may signal we are close; AI safety progress is now driven by capability needs, not just ethics.
pachocki.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得无意义，这或许意味着我们已接近；AI 安全进展如今由能力需求驱动，而非仅靠伦理。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning; RL alone suffices, so specialized continual learning labs are misguided.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他提出持续学习是核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现；仅靠强化学习就足够，因此专做持续学习的实验室方向有误。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding chain of thought in products preserves interpretability, and alignment optimism has risen despite shorter timelines.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他把思维链监控视为关键对齐工具，主张在产品中隐藏思维链以保留可解释性；尽管时间线缩短，他对对齐的乐观反而上升。

pachocki.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms; the biggest societal risk is power concentration from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他预判模型很快能自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式；最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily like software to discover emergent properties and user needs through real-world feedback.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；像软件一样每日迭代发布，通过真实世界反馈发现涌现能力与用户需求。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; it's like MS-DOS, and we haven't built Windows yet—the interface will evolve beyond turn-by-turn chat.
turley.zh: 聊天不是未来；它像 MS-DOS，我们还没造出 Windows——界面将超越逐轮对话而演化。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离：前沿模型走严格流程，但产品开发应最大程度加速。

turley.en: Retention is the north star, driven by friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements; growth came from these thirds.
turley.zh: 留存是北极星，由消除摩擦、核心产品投入与模型改进驱动；增长正来自这三部分。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models transform when productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、富含可供性的产品；推理模型在无缝产品化时带来变革。

carlpei.en: Survival is the core value; startups must pace themselves and start with simpler products before tackling complex ones.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调生存是核心价值观，创业公司要认清位置，先做简单产品证明自己，再挑战复杂产品。

carlpei.en: Hardware is hard and low-margin; Nothing must evolve beyond hardware toward applied AI and agentic software.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他仍认为硬件难做且利润最低，但主张 Nothing 必须超越硬件，转向面向消费者的应用 AI 与智能体式软件。

carlpei.en: Most AI is BS; AI should be an ingredient for utility, not a hype topic, and models will commoditize.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他反复说大多数 AI 是胡扯，AI 应作为提升实用体验的配料而非炒作话题，并预判模型将商品化、陷入价格战。

carlpei.en: Smartphones shift from app-based to intent-based; proactive agents act after trust, with voice input and visual output.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他深化判断：智能手机将从基于应用转向基于意图，智能体在建立信任后主动执行任务，最高效界面是语音输入加视觉输出。

carlpei.en: Design and marketing arbitrage differentiate challenger brands; make tech fun to inspire human creativity.
carlpei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：设计与营销套利是挑战者品牌的差异化手段，让科技变得有趣以激发人类创造力。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs point toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他把 AI 定位为延伸人类能力的工具，像显微镜和望远镜；并认为把一切输入都 tokenize 的通用智能体（如 Gato）是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video like YouTube can train agents without expensive reinforcement learning; robots should learn as humans do.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他强调从 YouTube 这类视频中学习，可以在不依赖昂贵强化学习的情况下训练智能体；机器人应像人类一样从视频中学习，而非只靠遥操作数据。

nando.en: Fundamental innovation can come from anywhere; large models are exciting but not everything.
nando.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终认为基础性创新可以来自任何地方，大模型令人兴奋但并非全部——这一主线贯穿始终。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; we still lack solutions.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他的重心明显转向 AI 安全与负责任部署，直言这是当下最大的挑战，而且我们还没有解决方案——相比 2023 年更强调风险与责任。

nando.en: Africa is not behind in AI; it leapfrogs legacy issues and holds unique advantages.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他进一步深化立场：非洲在 AI 上并不落后，反而因跨越式发展拥有独特优势，本地语言模型可变革教育——这是对早期多样性主张的具体落地。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; LLMs hallucinate because they lack grounded experience, and embodied worlds provide infinite data as internet tokens run out.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：LLM 产生幻觉源于缺乏具身带来的落地经验，而互联网高质量 token 正枯竭，具身世界能提供无限数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs act as operating systems—language as interface, tools as software, vector databases as hard disk—with reinforcement learning only a cherry on top of unsupervised learning.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他把 LLM 类比为操作系统：语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘；并认为强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习承担主要工作。

jimfan.en: Simulation enables massive parallelization and safe exploration for training embodied agents; simple, elegant solutions scale better than complex modular academic approaches.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他强调仿真为训练具身智能体提供大规模并行与安全探索，并坚持简单优雅的方案才可扩展，反对学术界常见的复杂模块化路线。

jimfan.en: The data problem is now the main robotics bottleneck; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，他把数据问题明确为机器人学的首要瓶颈，认为来自仿真与世界模型的合成数据才是扩展机器人学习的未来——从早期强调仿真训练，深化为以数据为中心的判断。

jimfan.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the physical Turing test and a GPT-3 moment for robotics are the grand challenges.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他主张用简单端到端模型整合多元数据来构建机器人基础模型，并把物理图灵测试与机器人领域的 GPT-3 时刻视为终极挑战，延续了其一贯的简洁可扩展主线。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning.
yejin.zh: 预训练提供广博知识，但基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）的后训练对安全、友好的回应至关重要；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题，而下一个词预测的预训练目标与人类学习根本错位。

yejin.en: Inference-time algorithms and high-quality AI-generated data can let smaller models match larger ones, so less compute may suffice.
yejin.zh: 推理阶段的算法与高质量 AI 生成数据能让更小的模型比肩大模型，因此用更少算力也可能足够。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge rather than transcending it, and RL needs careful engineering to beat supervised fine-tuning.
yejin.zh: 数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是对人类知识做插值，而非超越，强化学习需要精心工程才能胜过监督微调。

yejin.en: Open research and cross-institution collaboration are crucial to compete with closed frontier labs; abductive reasoning and falsification drive scientific discovery.
yejin.zh: 开放研究与跨机构合作对与封闭的前沿模型实验室竞争至关重要；溯因推理与证伪推动科学发现。

yejin.en: Small language models with diverse synthetic data and pluralistic alignment can outperform larger ones; RL as a pre-training objective yields lasting reasoning gains.
yejin.zh: 拥有多样合成数据与多元对齐的小语言模型可以胜过更大的模型；把强化学习作为预训练目标能带来持久的推理提升。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师应当写代码以建立共情并加快交付，消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; use familiar patterns, and chase ROI rather than perfecting every surface.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他反共识地主张不要在交互设计上创新，应沿用熟悉模式，并追求投入产出比而非把每个界面都做到完美。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他把设计从交付手段深化为战略武器，认为创始人必须讲清设计为何能帮公司取胜。

henrymodisett.en: Brand narrative is a recruiting tool; people join a brand, not a company, so invest early.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步提出品牌叙事是招聘工具，人们加入的是品牌而非公司，因此应尽早投入品牌。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity and decisiveness beat perfection; give designers ownership, and let gut decisions often beat data.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他更坚定地认为速度与决断胜过完美，应给设计师自主权，在快速增长的初创公司里直觉决策常胜过数据驱动。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; AI is a creative partner to jam with openly.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈，引导工程师并对齐问题；AI 是创作伙伴，可开放地即兴协作。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and is paid off iteratively alongside technical debt, through rapid scrappy experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务：会波动，需与技术债一起通过快速、粗糙的实验迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth; 90s layer-panel tools are legacy.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计工具的未来是互操作的，代码是唯一真相来源；90 年代图层面板式工具已是遗留产物。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams beat 8-10 person squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补足短板的通才最有价值；小团队优于 8-10 人的跨职能小队。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in the early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 如今已是基本要求；不采用它就像早期无视互联网一样。

sholto.en: Long context is underhyped; it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence, while agents lag on reliability, not long-horizon ability.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文被低估：它解决“上手”问题并大幅提升智能；智能体没起势主要是可靠性问题，而非长程任务能力。

sholto.en: RL on language models has no ceiling; pre-training plus RL may reach AGI, with reliability and time horizon as the axes.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他转向强化学习：语言模型上的强化学习没有上限，预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI，能力沿任务复杂度与时间跨度两轴提升。

sholto.en: Verifiable rewards in math and code drive expert performance; coding is the leading indicator and most tractable domain.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他深化到可验证奖励：数学与代码的可验证奖励带来专家级表现，编程是 AI 进展的领先指标，也是最可攻克的领域。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis; long agentic coherence expands what models can do, and Transformers suffice for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他把强化学习视为与预训练并列的新 Scaling（规模扩张）轴；更长的智能体式连贯性拓展模型能力，且 Transformer 足以通向 AGI。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration beats raw intelligence; compute is the bottleneck, and world models are not on the critical path.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他强调能力过剩：编排比原始智能更重要，算力是瓶颈，世界模型不在 AGI 关键路径上，软件-only 奇点可能先于物理世界到来。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict AI progress; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律能预测 AI 进步，但已提出测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为下一阶段的主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体虽前景可期但尚不真正好用，人机迭代协作仍是核心，并反共识地判断自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式。

truell.en: Benchmarks are poor proxies for real coding; frontier models struggle with bug finding and are poorly calibrated.
truell.zh: 2024 年他批评基准测试是真实编程的糟糕代理，指出前沿模型因缺乏训练数据而难以找 bug、校准也很差。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
truell.zh: 到 2025 年他把判断深化为：编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人始终掌握方向盘，品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更值钱。

truell.en: Custom models became essential to every magic moment in Cursor; the AI shift will outlast the internet and take decades.
truell.zh: 2025 年他坦言自研模型出乎意料地成为 Cursor 每个惊艳时刻的关键，并判断这场 AI 变革比互联网更具颠覆性、需数十年展开。

shazeer.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though neural nets remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为 LLM 通过下一个词预测解决了一个 AI 完全问题；Scaling（规模扩张）带来更聪明的 AI，但神经网络内部仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are major near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他转向强调推理时算力扩展与更长上下文窗口是近期重大机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial for AGI.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他深化观点：测试时算力扩展推动进步但无法单独实现 AGI；智能体式能力与强化学习对 AGI 至关重要。

shazeer.en: Scaling compute and data is the core driver of AI progress, from training to inference, with algorithmic advances complementing hardware scaling.
shazeer.zh: 始终：Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据是 AI 进步的核心驱动力，从训练到推理，算法进步与硬件扩展相辅相成。

shazeer.en: AI safety requires engineering safeguards, human oversight, and understanding model capabilities; big tech's risk aversion slows product launches.
shazeer.zh: 始终：AI 安全需要工程保障、人类监督与理解模型能力；大公司因风险规避而拖慢产品发布。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs both hardware and software breakthroughs; self-play, imitation, and fine-tuning pre-trained models drive progress, but long-horizon credit assignment still lacks hierarchical reasoning.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他认为机器人要击败费德勒需硬件与软件双重突破；自博弈、模仿学习与微调预训练模型是主要推动力，但长时程信用分配仍缺乏分层推理。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge belongs in data generation, not hard-coded networks, and pre-trained language models transfer reasoning to non-language tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他主张无监督学习结合强化学习可大幅提升样本效率；先验知识应用于数据生成而非硬编码进网络，预训练语言模型能把推理模式迁移到非语言任务。

abbeel.en: A consistent thread: transfer via fine-tuning large pre-trained models, and simulation/self-play as scalable learning signals for real-world robotics.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年一以贯之的主线：通过微调大型预训练模型实现迁移，并以模拟与自博弈作为可扩展的学习信号，服务于真实世界机器人。

abbeel.en: Reliability, not novelty, defines value: 99.9% reliability is the benchmark for warehouse robotics, and a single network can generalize across tasks and end effectors.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年他深化了落地标准：价值取决于可靠性而非新奇性，99.9%可靠性是仓储机器人的基准，单一网络可跨任务与末端执行器泛化。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; talent gap exceeds funding gap. Build skills, don't fear capability research. Alignment and robustness need empirical study.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究尚待开发，人才缺口大于资金缺口；应专注技能积累，不必过度担忧参与能力研究；对齐与鲁棒性需要实证研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale for superhuman outputs. Need scalable oversight, interpretability, automated alignment. Evaluation easier than generation, so alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展至超人输出，需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究；评估比生成容易，对齐可能比想象中简单。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved, compute promises broken. Post-training alone can't align AGI. Third-party testing and regulation like SB 1047 needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化侵蚀，超级对齐团队解散、算力承诺未兑现；仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），需要第三方测试和 SB 1047 等监管。

leike.en: Alignment is empirically testable and progress measurable. Interpretability is key to detect deception. Automated alignment research can iteratively bootstrap progress.
leike.zh: 始终，他坚持对齐可实证测试、进展可衡量；可解释性是检测欺骗的关键；自动化对齐研究能迭代推进。

leike.en: Biggest risk is uncertainty about how aligned a system truly is, not misalignment itself. More capable models may be more aligned on average but worst-case behavior can worsen.
leike.zh: 从 2023 到 2024 年，他深化观点：最大风险不是对齐失败本身，而是对系统是否真正对齐的不确定性；更强模型平均更对齐，但最坏情况可能更糟。
